items.title: 「不支持」還不夠！習近平要求川普明確「反對」台獨
items.title_en: "Not Supporting" Is Not Enough! Xi Jinping Demands Trump Explicitly "Oppose" Taiwan Independence
paras: 《彭博》報導，中國國家主席習近平週四 (24 日) 在白宮與美國總統川普舉行峰會時，要求美方正式表明「反對台灣獨立」，這是他迄今要求川普調整對台立場最明確的一次表態。
中國官媒新華社引述習近平表示，美國應「恪守反對台灣獨立的正確立場」，審慎處理台灣問題，為美中戰略合作奠定穩固基礎。
這是川普與習近平首度在白宮舉行峰會，會談時間不到兩小時。中國官媒在發布完整會談內容前，率先公布習近平涉及台灣的談話，凸顯北京將台灣問題列為美中關係中的優先議題。
習近平此次要求美方「反對台灣獨立」，用語比拜登政府過去所稱的「不支持台灣獨立」更為強烈。
曾在拜登及川普政府國家安全會議負責中國與台灣事務的彭博經濟學家 Jennifer Welch 表示，這看似只是語意上的調整，實際影響卻可能相當顯著。
Welch指出，中國可能利用美方措辭變化，削弱台灣對美國支持的信心。「反對台灣獨立」意味美方必須採取更積極的行動，遏制北京所認定的台獨力量，而不只是表明不支持台灣追求正式獨立。
美方若改變措辭，也可能加深外界對台灣成為美中談判籌碼的疑慮。
川普政府已將一項規模 140 億美元的對台軍售案延後數月。川普今年 5 月在北京與習近平會面後，曾形容這項軍售是美國「非常好的談判籌碼」，相關說法引發台灣不安。
北京此次再度要求川普表態之際，也正在調整對台施壓方式。中國一方面減少具挑釁性的軍事行動，另一方面則加強外交孤立，包括向其他國家施壓，阻止總統賴清德的專機飛越其領空。
美國如何描述對台關係，長期以來一直是美中之間的敏感議題。據知情人士先前透露，中國在 2025 年便曾要求川普政府正式宣布「反對台灣獨立」。
美台關係自 1982 年以來，也受到美國前總統雷根提出的「六項保證」影響。相關內容刻意不明確界定台灣主權，但明確表示，美國不會就對台軍售事宜與中國協商，也不會修改要求華府向台灣提供防禦性武器的《台灣關係法》。
川普對台灣的公開立場與前總統拜登有所不同。拜登任內曾表示，如果中國入侵台灣，美國將出兵協防；川普則要求台灣官員提升自我防衛能力。
華府布魯金斯學會中國中心主任 Ryan Hass 表示，習近平正試圖把「建設性戰略穩定」與反對台灣獨立連結。中國官員今年 5 月提出這項說法，作為界定新階段美中關係的概念。
Hass 認為，接下來真正的檢驗標準，是川普將如何表述美國的台灣立場，而不只是習近平要求他接受什麼立場。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Bloomberg reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday (the 24th) at a summit in the White House with U.S. President Donald Trump demanded that the United States formally state its "opposition to Taiwan independence," the clearest request so far for Trump to adjust his Taiwan stance.

China’s state news agency Xinhua quoted Xi as saying the United States should "adhere to the correct position of opposing Taiwan independence," handle the Taiwan issue prudently, and lay a solid foundation for strategic cooperation between the two countries.

This was the first summit between Trump and Xi held at the White House, lasting less than two hours. Before releasing the full meeting transcript, Chinese state media first published Xi’s remarks on Taiwan, highlighting that Beijing is treating the Taiwan issue as a priority in U.S.-China relations.
Xi’s demand that the U.S. "oppose Taiwan independence" uses stronger language than the Biden administration’s previous phrasing of "not supporting Taiwan independence."

Jennifer Welch, a Bloomberg economist who handled China and Taiwan issues for both the Biden and Trump administrations’ National Security Councils, said the change may seem merely semantic but could have a markedly significant impact.

Welch noted that China could use the U.S. wording shift to erode Taiwan’s confidence in American support. "Opposing Taiwan independence" implies the U.S. must take more active steps to curb what Beijing deems separatist forces, not just state a lack of support for formal independence.
If the U.S. changes its phrasing, it could also deepen external doubts that Taiwan is becoming a bargaining chip in U.S.-China negotiations.

The Trump administration has delayed a $14 billion arms sale to Taiwan by several months. After meeting Xi in Beijing in May, Trump described the sale as a "very good negotiating chip" for the United States, a comment that unsettled Taiwan.

As Beijing again pressed Trump for a statement, it is also adjusting its pressure tactics on Taiwan: reducing provocative military actions while intensifying diplomatic isolation, including pressuring other countries to prevent President Lai Ching‑te’s aircraft from overflying its airspace.

How the United States characterises its relationship with Taiwan has long been a sensitive issue in U.S.-China ties. Insiders previously disclosed that China had asked the Trump administration as early as 2025 to formally announce its "opposition to Taiwan independence."

U.S.-Taiwan relations since 1982 have also been shaped by former President Reagan’s "Six Assurances," which deliberately avoid a clear definition of Taiwan’s sovereignty but state unequivocally that the U.S. will not negotiate arms sales to Taiwan with China and will not amend the Taiwan Relations Act that requires Washington to provide defensive weapons to Taiwan.

Trump’s public stance on Taiwan differs from that of former President Biden. Biden said that if China invaded Taiwan, the United States would intervene militarily; Trump, by contrast, urged Taiwanese officials to boost their own self‑defence capabilities.

Ryan Hass, director of the Brookings Institution’s China Center, said Xi is trying to link "constructive strategic stability" with opposition to Taiwan independence. Chinese officials put forward this framing in May as a way to define a new phase of U.S.-China relations.
Hass believes the real test going forward will be how Trump articulates the United States’ Taiwan position, not merely what Xi asks him to adopt.

items.title: 習近平要求川普「反對台灣獨立」 再提「修昔底德陷阱」
items.title_en: Xi Jinping Urges Trump to “Oppose Taiwan Independence” and Raises “Thucydides Trap” Again
paras: 美國總統川普週四 (24 日) 盛讚他與中國國家主席習近平建立的「真正深厚的友誼」。習近平展開備受矚目的國是訪問之際，則呼籲全球兩大經濟體更緊密合作，避免在競爭中產生摩擦。習近平於會談中要求川普「審慎處理台灣問題」，並再提「修昔底德陷阱」。
川普有許多棘手議題要與這位美國最大經濟競爭對手的領導人討論，但兩人在幕僚陪同下、於正式會談前發表開場談話時，他著重談及自己與習近平長年的關係。
川普說：「自從我 2016 年首次當選以來，習主席與我建立了友誼。事實上，那是一段真正深厚的友誼，建立在相互尊重，以及兩國人民切身利益的基礎上。」
中國迄今未接受川普政府的敦促及經濟施壓，運用自身影響力促使伊朗同意美方提出的停戰條件。這場戰爭已持續近 7 個月。習近平則希望川普永久停止對台軍售，並放寬先進晶片出口限制。雙方週三同意，將原定 11 月 10 日到期、為期 1 年的貿易休戰延長 2 個月，同時尋求更持久的協議。
習近平向川普提台灣議題
據中國官媒《新華社》報導，習近平在閉門會談中也要求川普「審慎處理台灣問題」，敦促美國正式「反對」台灣獨立。
習近平強調，中方維護國家統一和領土完整的立場很清楚。希望美方堅持反對「台獨」的正確立場，慎重處理台灣問題，為美中戰略合作與兩國關係發展奠定堅實基礎。
中國多次要求華府永久停止對台軍售，包括川普與習近平今年 5 月在北京會面時。那次會面後，川普表示，他暫緩最終批准一項正在推進、規模達 140 億美元的軍售案；他也將對台軍售形容為與中國談判時「非常好的籌碼」。
習近平再提「修昔底德陷阱」
習近平指出，美中建設性戰略穩定關係的新定位反映了美中關係的現實，也體現了對未來的期許，是邁向兩國正確相處之道的重要一步。雙方要把這個願景轉化為行動，開創中美關係更穩定、健康、永續的未來。
習近平公開發言的措辭比川普更為直接。他說，美中兩國利益「深度交融」，競爭應該是良性的、有界線的，應該是你追我趕的賽跑，而不是你輸我贏的角斗。
他再次警告，美中必須避免「修昔底德陷阱」，兩國軍隊要維持常態化對話，完善危機溝通和預防機制。川普今年 5 月訪問北京時，習近平也曾提出類似警告。
「修昔底德陷阱」概念指的是，當崛起中的強權威脅取代既有強權時，雙方往往可能走向戰爭。
習近平還宣布，中國將在未來 5 年邀請 10 萬名美國青年赴中學習、交流，並向亞特蘭大動物園贈送兩隻貓熊「平平」與「福雙」。他稱貓熊為「中美兩國人民友誼的使者」，表示牠們將在「幾天內」與美國民眾見面。
習近平：AI 應始終處於人類控制之下
川普週四稍早在社群媒體發文表示，人工智慧將是會談的主要議題之一。他試圖將這項技術重新稱為「超級智慧」。全球對 AI 可能取代工作，甚至危及人類存續的憂慮正持續升高。
川普寫道：「我希望讓它維持現狀。中國的立場也是如此。」
習近平在開場談話中也提到 AI，表示兩國有責任確保 AI 始終由人類掌控。
習近平說：「我們有能力，也有責任為善而發展、管理人工智慧，確保人工智慧的發展始終處於人類控制之下，並造福人民。」
美中財長本週稍早曾會面，美方提議建立兩國之間的 AI 事故「通報機制」。
談及中東局勢
習近平指出，中方一直認為，各國的主權和安全都要受到尊重，始終在為緩局降溫發揮建設性作用，鼓勵各方堅持和平選擇，保持談判動能。
中方支持美伊兩國回歸伊斯蘭堡諒解備忘錄，希望雙方盡早重回對話談判解決問題的軌道，最終達成包括核問題在內的全面協議，盡早實現和平
川普高規格接待習近平 引發部分盟友批評
川普已表明，他希望這次訪問能讓習近平留下深刻印象。他確保白宮南草坪的新直升機停機坪在訪問前完工；週三晚間，習近平與夫人彭麗媛飛抵華府附近的安德魯斯聯合基地時，川普也到場迎接。
白宮安排了隆重的閱兵儀式，供兩國領導人與配偶在橢圓形辦公室會談前觀禮。儀式結束後，第一夫人梅蘭妮亞 (Melania Trump) 陪同習近平夫人彭麗媛參觀史密森尼國家亞洲藝術博物館。
會談約 90 分鐘後，川普與習近平來到南草坪。川普帶習近平參觀新的白宮直升機停機坪與總統直升機「陸戰隊一號」。兩人似乎也從遠處觀看宴會廳工地。習近平在簡短參觀後離開白宮，預定晚間返回出席國宴。
川普在參觀後簡短向記者表示：「我們談得很好。」
兩國領導人稍晚將在白宮東廳出席正式晚宴，餐點包括鱸魚。晚宴採紅色布置，並將舉杯紀念已故總統尼克森。尼克森 1972 年訪問中國，促成兩國於 1979 年建交；美國也在同一時期與台灣斷絕正式外交關係。
川普高規格接待習近平的決定，招致兩黨國會議員及部分白宮盟友批評。
密西西比州共和黨參議員Roger Wicker 說：「坦白說，如果白宮徵詢意見，考量到美方與習近平主席及中國共產黨之間存在的種種令人憂心的問題，我會建議川普總統不要邀請習近平到華府，接受如此隆重的接待。」
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday (the 24th) lavishly praised the "genuine deep friendship" he has built with Chinese President Xi Jinping. As Xi embarked on his highly watched state visit, he called for tighter cooperation between the world’s two largest economies to avoid frictions in competition. During their talks, Xi asked Trump to "handle the Taiwan issue prudently" and again warned of the "Thucydides Trap."

Trump has many thorny issues to discuss with the leader of America’s biggest economic rival, but before the formal meeting, both leaders, accompanied by their staff, delivered opening remarks that focused on Trump’s long‑standing relationship with Xi.

Trump said: "Since I was first elected in 2016, President Xi and I have built a friendship. In fact, it is a truly deep friendship founded on mutual respect and the vital interests of our two peoples."

China has so far not yielded to the Trump administration’s pressure and economic coercion, using its influence to get Iran to accept the cease‑fire terms proposed by the United States. The war has now lasted nearly seven months. Xi hopes Trump will permanently halt arms sales to Taiwan and ease restrictions on advanced chip exports. The two sides agreed on Wednesday to extend the one‑year trade truce, originally set to expire on November 10, by two months while seeking a more durable agreement.
Xi Jinping raised the Taiwan issue with Trump
According to China’s state news agency Xinhua, Xi asked Trump in a closed‑door meeting to "handle the Taiwan issue prudently" and urged the United States to formally "oppose" Taiwan independence.

Xi stressed that China’s stance on safeguarding national unity and territorial integrity is crystal clear. He hopes the U.S. will stick to the correct position of opposing "Taiwan independence," handle the Taiwan issue carefully, and lay a solid foundation for strategic U.S.–China cooperation and the development of bilateral relations.

China has repeatedly asked Washington to permanently stop arms sales to Taiwan, including during Trump’s May meeting with Xi in Beijing. After that meeting, Trump said he was postponing final approval of a $14 billion arms deal that was moving forward; he also described U.S. arms sales to Taiwan as a "very good bargaining chip" in negotiations with China.
Xi Jinping again raised the "Thucydides Trap"

Xi pointed out that the new positioning of a constructive, strategically stable U.S.–China relationship reflects the reality of the bilateral ties and embodies hopes for the future. It is an important step toward a proper way for the two countries to get along. Both sides must turn this vision into action and forge a more stable, healthy, and sustainable future for U.S.–China relations.

Xi’s public language was even more direct than Trump’s. He said the interests of the United States and China are "deeply intertwined," competition should be healthy and bounded, like a race where both run, not a gladiatorial bout where one wins and the other loses.

He warned again that the U.S. and China must avoid the "Thucydides Trap," that their militaries should maintain routine dialogue, and that crisis communication and prevention mechanisms need to be improved. When Trump visited Beijing in May, Xi issued a similar warning.
The "Thucydides Trap" concept refers to the tendency for a rising power to threaten an established one, often leading the two toward war.

Xi also announced that China will invite 100,000 American youths to study and exchange in China over the next five years, and will gift the Atlanta Zoo two giant pandas, "Pingping" and "Fushuang." He called the pandas "messengers of friendship between the peoples of China and the United States" and said they will meet the American public "in a few days."
Xi: AI Must Remain Under Human Control

Earlier on Thursday, Trump posted on social media that artificial intelligence would be a major topic of the talks. He tried to rebrand the technology as "super intelligence." Global concerns that AI could replace jobs or even threaten human survival continue to rise.
Trump wrote: "I want to keep it as it is. China’s stance is the same."
Xi also mentioned AI in his opening remarks, saying the two countries have a responsibility to ensure AI always remains under human control.
Xi said: "We have the capability and the responsibility to develop and manage artificial intelligence for good, to keep its development always under human control and to benefit the people."
U.S. and Chinese finance ministers met earlier this week, with the U.S. proposing the creation of an AI‑incident reporting mechanism between the two countries.
Discussing the Middle‑East situation

Xi noted that China has always believed that every nation’s sovereignty and security must be respected, and that China consistently plays a constructive role in de‑escalating tensions, encouraging all parties to choose peace and maintain negotiation momentum.

China supports the U.S. and Iran returning to the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding, hoping both sides will quickly resume dialogue and negotiations to resolve issues, ultimately reaching a comprehensive agreement that includes the nuclear question and achieving peace as soon as possible.
Trump’s high‑profile reception of Xi draws criticism from some allies

Trump has made clear he hopes the visit will leave a lasting impression on Xi. He ensured the new helicopter landing pad on the White House South Lawn was completed before the visit; on Wednesday evening, when Xi and his wife Peng Liyuan arrived at the Andrews Air Force Base near Washington, Trump was on hand to greet them.

The White House staged a grand ceremony for the two leaders and their spouses to watch before their Oval Office meeting. After the ceremony, First Lady Melania Trump escorted Peng Liyuan on a tour of the Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art.

After about a 90‑minute meeting, Trump and Xi walked to the South Lawn. Trump showed Xi the new White House helicopter pad and the presidential helicopter "Marine One." The two also glanced from a distance at the banquet hall construction site. After a brief tour, Xi left the White House, slated to return later that evening for the state dinner.
After the tour, Trump told reporters briefly, "We had a very good talk."

Later, the two leaders will attend a formal dinner in the White House East Room, featuring sea bass. The dinner will be decorated in red and will include a toast to the late President Nixon. Nixon’s 1972 visit to China paved the way for diplomatic relations in 1979; the United States also severed formal diplomatic ties with Taiwan at that time.
Trump’s decision to give Xi a lavish reception has drawn criticism from members of both parties in Congress and some White House allies.

Mississippi Republican Senator Roger Wicker said, "Frankly, if the White House were to consult me, given the many concerning issues between the U.S., President Xi and the Chinese Communist Party, I would advise President Trump not to invite President Xi to Washington and not to give such a grand reception."

items.title: 美參院一票之差否決決議案 川普對伊朗動武權限未受限
items.title_en: U.S. Senate Defeats Resolution by One Vote, Leaving Trump’s Authority to Use Force Against Iran Unrestricted
paras: 美國參議院週四 (24 日) 以 49 票贊成、50 票反對，否決要求川普政府結束對伊朗戰事的決議案。4 名共和黨參議員倒戈、加入民主黨陣營，但多數共和黨人仍支持川普。這項決議案已於 7 月在眾議院過關，參院表決結果也讓國會能否制衡總統戰爭權限，再度成為期中選舉焦點。
決議案要求總統將美軍撤出對伊朗政府及軍方的敵對行動，包括可能投入作戰或占領任務的地面部隊；除非國會正式宣戰，或明確授權對伊朗使用武力。眾議院先前以 214 票對 208 票通過該案。
參院投票大致依政黨立場分歧。肯塔基州共和黨參議員Rand Paul、緬因州參議員Susan Collins、阿拉斯加州參議員Lisa Murkowski，以及北卡羅來納州參議員 Thom Tillis 投下贊成票；賓州民主黨參議員John Fetterman 則是唯一投反對票的民主黨人。
即使參院通過，這項共同決議案也不會送交川普簽署或否決，主要作用是表達國會立場。
推動決議案的民主黨參議員Tim Kaine 強調，美國憲法將宣戰權賦予國會。他表示，國會議員也應聽取受戰爭影響的民眾及軍人家庭的聲音。
伊朗戰事的影響已從戰場延伸至美國民生。報導指出，自美國今年 2 月開始對伊朗發動軍事打擊以來，伊朗在荷姆茲海峽的反擊使當地成為戰區；美國汽油、柴油、肥料與食品價格均已上漲。這場戰爭也已造成 19 名美軍人員死亡。
戰爭的民意支持度同樣對共和黨構成壓力。
《NBC News》近期民調顯示，33% 的登記選民認為伊朗戰爭「值得」，62% 認為「不值得」。在候選人選擇上，57% 的選民表示更可能支持反對戰爭的人選，24% 則持相反立場。
儘管共和黨在參眾兩院的多數議員仍支持川普，部分面臨選戰的共和黨人已改變態度。
《NBC News》指出，密西根州參議員候選人Mike Rogers，以及愛荷華州聯邦眾議員Ashley Hinson，近期都呼籲結束戰爭；兩人先前曾支持川普對伊朗的政策。
川普則持續為戰爭辯護，主張美國必須削弱伊朗，防止其取得核武。
他在聯合國演說中表示，若伊朗政權能在核武保護下發動大規模恐怖攻擊，將構成美國必須面對的威脅。
paras_en: On Thursday, September 24, the U.S. Senate voted 49‑50 to reject a resolution demanding that the Trump administration end hostilities against Iran. Four Republican senators broke ranks and joined Democrats, but most Republicans continued to back Trump. The measure had already passed the House in July, and the Senate vote revived debate over whether Congress can curb the president’s war powers ahead of the midterm elections.

The resolution called for the president to withdraw U.S. forces from hostile actions against the Iranian government and military, including any ground troops that might be deployed for combat or occupation, unless Congress formally declares war or explicitly authorizes the use of force against Iran. The House had approved the bill 214‑208.

Senate voting largely fell along party lines. Republican senators Rand Paul of Kentucky, Susan Collins of Maine, Lisa Murkowski of Alaska, and Thom Tillis of North Carolina voted in favor; Democratic senator John Fetterman of Pennsylvania was the sole Democrat to vote against it.
Even if the Senate had passed it, the joint resolution would not have been sent to Trump for signature or veto; its primary purpose is to express Congress’s position.

Democratic senator Tim Kaine, who championed the resolution, stressed that the Constitution grants the power to declare war to Congress. He said members of Congress should also listen to the voices of citizens and military families affected by the war.

The impact of the Iran conflict has spilled over into everyday American life. Reports note that since the United States began striking Iran in February, Iranian retaliation in the Strait of Hormuz has turned the area into a combat zone, and U.S. gasoline, diesel, fertilizer and food prices have all risen. The war has also claimed the lives of 19 U.S. service members.
Public support for the war is also putting pressure on Republicans.

A recent NBC News poll shows that 33 % of registered voters think the war with Iran is “worth it,” while 62 % say it is “not worth it.” When asked about candidate preferences, 57 % say they are more likely to support a candidate who opposes the war, compared with 24 % who would favor a pro‑war candidate.
Although Republicans still hold majorities in both chambers and many continue to back Trump, some GOP office‑seekers have begun to shift their stance.

NBC News reported that Michigan Senate candidate Mike Rogers and Iowa Representative Ashley Hinson have recently called for an end to the war, even though both previously supported Trump’s policy toward Iran.
Trump has continued to defend the war, arguing that the United States must weaken Iran to prevent it from acquiring nuclear weapons.

In a speech to the United Nations, he warned that if the Iranian regime were able to launch a large‑scale terrorist attack under the protection of nuclear weapons, it would pose a threat the United States must confront.

items.title: 小摩調升Meta目標價 看好Muse成ChatGPT後最普及AI應用
items.title_en: JPMorgan Raises Meta Target Price, Sees Muse as the Most Widely Used AI Application Since ChatGPT
paras: Meta(META-US) 新推出的 AI 智能體 Muse 本週帶動科技股上漲。該公司週三(23日)晚間在 Connect 大會展示新產品後，獲摩根大通調高目標價。
Doug Anmuth 領導的摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 分析師團隊將 Meta 目標價從 820 美元調升至 920 美元。Meta 股價過去一個月已上漲 30%。
摩根大通看好 Muse，認為它有望成為 ChatGPT 問世以來使用最廣泛的消費級 AI 應用。
Meta 週三晚間表示，Muse 現已可透過連接器與沃爾瑪(WMT-US) 、百思買(BBY-US) 、絲芙蘭及 Wayfair(W-US) 的服務串接；值得注意的是，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 禁止 Muse 存取其商店。
摩根大通分析師表示，隨著時間推進，Meta 應能透過分潤比例或佣金模式，將此類銷售模式變現。
Brian Nowak 領導的摩根士丹利(MS-US) 分析師團隊則維持 Meta 目標價 775 美元。他們表示，Meta 推出的新款眼鏡更輕、更不笨重，可能終於在虛擬實境眼鏡上取得突破。
分析師指出，儘管他們和多數投資人近年對 Meta 的擴增實境及虛擬實境業務抱持懷疑態度，這款產品在體積與功能上確實有明顯進步，值得關注能否成為 2027 年股價進一步上漲的動力；目前 Meta 股價尚未反映這項業務成功的可能性。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) launched its new AI assistant Muse this week, boosting tech stocks. After the company showcased the product at the Connect conference on Wednesday night (the 23rd), JPMorgan upgraded its target price.
Analysts led by Doug Anmuth at JPMorgan (JPM-US) lifted Meta’s target price from $820 to $920. Meta’s share price has risen 30% over the past month.
JPMorgan is optimistic about Muse, believing it could become the most widely used consumer‑grade AI application since the debut of ChatGPT.

Meta said Wednesday night that Muse is now available through connectors to Walmart (WMT-US), Best Buy (BBY-US), Sephora and Wayfair (W-US); notably, Amazon (AMZN-US) has blocked Muse from accessing its store.
JPMorgan analysts noted that, over time, Meta could monetize this sales model via revenue‑share or commission structures.

Brian Nowak’s team at Morgan Stanley (MS-US) kept Meta’s target price at $775, saying the new glasses are lighter and less bulky, potentially finally delivering a breakthrough in virtual‑reality headsets.

Analysts pointed out that, although they and most investors have been skeptical of Meta’s AR and VR businesses in recent years, this product shows clear improvements in size and functionality and could be a catalyst for further stock gains in 2027; the current share price does not yet reflect that upside potential.

items.title: 債券也能賺得像股票 前雷曼交易員驚見「1987年股災前兆」
items.title_en: Bonds Can Yield Like Stocks, Former Lehman Trader Sees ‘1987 Crash Warning’
paras: 前雷曼兄弟交易員麥唐納（Larry McDonald）指出，債券殖利率開始帶來「媲美股票的報酬」，對股市不是好消息。
他在《The David Lin Report》播客節目中表示，當前市場情勢與1987年「黑色星期一」股災前幾個月有相似之處。
麥唐納指出，美股當年於8月見頂，道瓊工業平均指數在該月創下歷史新高，但在短短兩個月後，便創下單日最大跌幅紀錄，跌幅將近23%。
他提到，正是在那個夏天，債券開始提供「媲美股市的報酬率」。回顧1987年，美國10年期公債殖利率一度攀升至9.89%，英國10年期公債殖利率更衝上10.12%。
新冠疫情期間，各國央行將利率降至接近零的水準，促使企業紛紛發行殖利率相對較低的長期債券，例如蘋果發行、將於2060年到期且票面利率僅2.55%的債券。然而，當央行重啟升息循環後，新發行的債券殖利率大幅跳升，迫使舊債券必須折價求售。
他說：「為什麼觀眾現在應該關心這件事？因為債券可能帶來媲美股票的報酬，開始從股市吸走資金。」
以Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 為例，該公司於2026年2月發行了規模達10億英鎊（約13.2億美元）、幾近平價發行的百年期債券。但在夏季過後，其價格跌至原值的87%左右，推動殖利率攀升至7%以上。
他補充說明，甲骨文(ORCL-US) 的長期債券殖利率也出現類似的飆升走勢，落在7%至8%之間。依照以72除以報酬率、估算資金翻倍所需年數的「72法則」，他認為投資約9年就能翻倍。
麥唐納強調，資金能在9年內翻倍就是股票級的報酬，這將開始瓜分股市的資金。
儘管債券若再往下修正一波，將孕育出「絕佳的買點」，但麥唐納也指出，能源價格的狂飆正持續推升經濟衰退的風險。
paras_en: Former Lehman Brothers trader Larry McDonald said bond yields are beginning to deliver "stock‑like returns," which is not good news for equities.
He told The David Lin Report podcast that today’s market conditions resemble the months leading up to the 1987 "Black Monday" crash.

McDonald noted that the U.S. market peaked in August that year, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average hitting an all‑time high, only to suffer its biggest one‑day drop – nearly 23% – just two months later.

He added that it was that summer that bonds started offering "returns comparable to the stock market." In 1987 U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields briefly rose to 9.89% and U.K. 10‑year yields surged to 10.12%.

During the COVID‑19 pandemic, central banks cut rates to near‑zero, prompting companies to issue long‑dated bonds with relatively low yields, such as Apple’s 2.55% coupon bond maturing in 2060. When central banks resumed rate hikes, new‑issue yields jumped, forcing older bonds to be sold at discounts.
He asked, "Why should listeners care now? Because bonds may deliver stock‑like returns and start siphoning capital away from equities."

Using Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) as an example, the company issued a £1 billion (about $1.32 billion) near‑par centennial bond in February 2026, but its price fell to roughly 87% of par after the summer, pushing the yield above 7%.

He added that Oracle’s (ORCL‑US) long‑dated bonds have seen a similar yield surge, landing in the 7%‑8% range. Applying the "Rule of 72" – dividing 72 by the return rate – suggests capital could double in about nine years.
McDonald stressed that a nine‑year doubling of capital is stock‑level performance and will begin to carve out equity funding.
He warned that while another pull‑back in bonds could create a "perfect buying opportunity," soaring energy prices are keeping recession risks elevated.

items.title: AI代理人掀浪潮！Meta Muse跨界衝擊 防禦型股票也難逃
items.title_en: AI Agents Spark a Wave! Meta's Muse Cross‑Industry Impact Makes Defensive Stocks Hard to Escape
paras: Meta Platforms(META-US)本月初推出代理型人工智慧(AI)Muse，把更多決策權交到消費者手中，然而這也讓過去被視為「AI防禦型」的企業與股票面臨新的風險。
不同於單純回答問題的聊天機器人，Muse能根據簡單指令，在用戶只需少量介入的情況下完成一連串任務。根據Cantor Fitzgerald分析師Deepak Mathivanan，Muse在推出初期已展現足以帶動快速普及的好兆頭。
但Muse也引發華爾街擔憂，代理型AI的普及可能衝擊那些仰賴消費者出於習慣或自動扣款，而持續購買產品與服務的企業，也就是高盛分析師所稱的「消費慣性」(consumer inertia)股票。

消費慣性成企業新風險

Muse能執行查詢用戶定期付款、取消訂閱等任務，這項功能可望讓消費者更容易停止不需要的服務，卻可能對那些能從消費者忽略或忘記扣款中獲益的企業造成壓力。
Neostellar Capital負責人Jackson Stone說：「Muse與Instinct等AI代理人，實際上正在降低消費者採取行動的摩擦成本。」面臨顛覆風險的狀況，包括消費者持續支付未使用的訂閱服務、不主動尋找更優惠的價格，或認為取消與轉換服務太麻煩等情況。
因此，可能受到影響的企業包括健身業者Planet Fitness(PLNT-US)、新聞網站《紐約時報》、保險公司Allstate(ALL-US)、串流服務Netflix(NFLX-US)、旅遊訂房平台Tripadvisor，以及報稅軟體公司Intuit(INTU-US)。這些股票周三(23日)再度收黑，延續周二的頹勢。
AI衝擊部分產業的疑慮其實早已存在：依賴網站流量投放廣告的新聞業者，網站流量已見下滑，聊天機器人和Google AI摘要都降低使用者點擊網站的需求，可能進而衝擊廣告業務。
但代理型AI如今可能進一步衝擊過去看似較不容易受到AI影響的產業，例如健身房與串流服務。

AI不只降低取消門檻 也可能刺激消費

不過Stone認為，情況不必然全是負面，原因在於，這些AI代理人不僅能降低取消或轉換服務的摩擦成本，也可能降低購買門檻。
他指出，如果AI代理人能讓消費者從「產生購買意願」到「完成交易」所需的步驟大幅減少，對於能有效承接這類需求的企業而言，可能成為重要的成長動能。
在其他股票因AI代理人衝擊疑慮而下跌之際，Meta股價反而上揚，周三漲1%至每股744.10美元，自Muse本月8日推出以來累計漲幅已達約21%。
paras_en: Meta Platforms (META‑US) launched its agent‑type artificial intelligence (AI) Muse earlier this month, handing more decision‑making power to consumers, but this also exposes companies and stocks previously seen as “AI defensive” to new risks.

Unlike simple question‑answer chatbots, Muse can execute a series of tasks based on simple commands with minimal user involvement. According to Cantor Fitzgerald analyst Deepak Mathivanan, Muse has shown early signs that could drive rapid adoption.

However, Muse has raised Wall Street concerns that the proliferation of agent‑type AI could hit firms that rely on consumers’ habitual or automatic payments to continuously purchase products and services – the “consumer inertia” stocks cited by Goldman Sachs analysts.

Consumer inertia becomes a new corporate risk. Muse can query users’ recurring payments, cancel subscriptions and similar tasks, making it easier for consumers to drop unwanted services, which could pressure companies that profit from consumers overlooking or forgetting charges.

Jackson Stone, head of Neostellar Capital, said: “Muse and other AI agents like Instinct are actually lowering the friction cost for consumers to take action.” The disruption risk includes scenarios where consumers keep paying for unused subscriptions, don’t actively seek better prices, or find canceling and switching services too cumbersome.

Consequently, potentially affected firms include gym operator Planet Fitness (PLNT‑US), news site The New York Times, insurer Allstate (ALL‑US), streaming service Netflix (NFLX‑US), travel‑booking platform Tripadvisor, and tax‑software company Intuit (INTU‑US). These stocks closed lower again on Wednesday the 23rd, extending Tuesday’s decline.

Concerns that AI could hit certain industries have existed for a while: news outlets that depend on website traffic for advertising have already seen traffic dip, and chatbots and Google AI summaries reduce users’ need to click through sites, potentially hurting ad revenue.
But agent‑type AI may now further affect sectors previously thought less vulnerable to AI, such as gyms and streaming services.
Stone believes the situation isn’t necessarily all negative because these AI agents not only lower the friction of canceling or switching services but could also lower the barrier to purchase.

He notes that if AI agents can dramatically cut the steps from “generating purchase intent” to “completing a transaction,” they could become a significant growth engine for companies that can capture that demand.
While other stocks fell on worries about AI agents, Meta’s share price rose, gaining 1% on Wednesday to $744.10 per share, up about 21% cumulatively since Muse’s launch on the 8th of this month.

items.title: 標普500從未如此依賴兩檔股票 蘋果、輝達權重合計破15%
items.title_en: S&P 500 Has Never Been So Dependent on Two Stocks: Apple and Nvidia Combined Weight Exceeds 15%
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 與輝達(NVDA-US) 對美股的影響力愈來愈大。財務規劃公司 Creative Planning 總裁彼得．馬盧克（Peter Mallouk）指出，標普 500 指數從未像現在這樣集中於兩檔股票。
蘋果與輝達合計占指數權重逾 15%，遠高於網路泡沫破裂前；微軟(MSFT-US) 與奇異(GE-US) 合計占比的 9.1%。
兩家公司股價持續上漲，也推升了它們在標普 500 指數中的權重。蘋果股價週二觸及 345 美元，創歷史新高；隨後美國 10 年期公債殖利率走升、整體股市回落，股價也自高點小幅回檔。
蘋果本月稍早發表 iPhone 18 與首款摺疊手機 Duo 後，股價一路走強，今年以來累計上漲 25%。
輝達則在 8 月下旬表示，下個會計年度業務至少可成長 70%。執行長黃仁勳指出，若沒有供應限制，成長率將超過 100%。輝達股價今年以來累計上漲 21%。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) and Nvidia (NVDA-US) are exerting ever‑greater influence on U.S. equities. Peter Mallouk, president of financial‑planning firm Creative Planning, said the S&P 500 has never been as concentrated in just two stocks as it is now.

Together, Apple and Nvidia account for more than 15% of the index’s weighting—far above the level seen before the dot‑com bust; by contrast, Microsoft (MSFT-US) and General Electric (GE-US) together make up only 9.1%.

Both companies’ share prices have kept climbing, boosting their weights in the S&P 500. Apple hit $345 on Tuesday, a record high; after that, the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield rose and the broader market slipped, pulling Apple’s price back slightly from its peak.
Apple’s stock has been strong since it unveiled the iPhone 18 and its first foldable phone, the Duo, earlier this month, gaining about 25% year‑to‑date.

Nvidia said in late August that its business will grow by at least 70% in the next fiscal year. CEO Jensen Huang noted that without supply constraints, growth could exceed 100%. Nvidia’s shares are up roughly 21% so far this year.

items.title: 亞洲債券市場8月罕見遭外資淨拋售 學者：全球現象波及
items.title_en: Asian Bond Market Experiences Rare Net Outflow by Foreign Investors in August, Scholar Says It's a Global Phenomenon
paras: 根據監管機構與債券市場協會數據顯示，今年8月外資由買轉賣減持亞洲債券，為5個月來首度呈現單月淨流出，打破前數月資金持續湧入亞洲債市的格局。
其中，南韓、馬來西亞、印度、印尼及泰國等5國債市合計遭外資淨賣出4.57億美元；尤以南韓市場流出規模最大，單月遭賣出約54億美元，中斷了先前連續4個月的買超態勢。此趨勢與6月亞洲債市吸引高達115.1億美元淨流入的大規模押注形成鮮明對比。
市場客觀數據顯示，資金轉向的主因與美債殖利率飆升直接相關，10年期美債殖利率一度升破5%創下近20年新高，疊加全球主要央行維持高利率的預期，大幅削弱了亞洲債券的相對利差優勢。
針對此波資金流向的轉變，中國社會科學院助理研究員倪淑慧表示，美債及主要發達國家國債殖利率上揚，引發全球債券同步賣壓，進而波及亞洲債市。不過，在亞洲各國殖利率分化的背景下，中國10年期國債殖利率約1.7%，展現較佳的穩定性與抗風險能力，人民幣國債仍具備分散投資的對沖價值。
法國里昂商學院教授李徽徽分析，6月的外資流入本質上是提前押注降息的「順週期搶籌」，而8月則是面對高資金成本時的「獲利了結」。針對南韓市場，他指出短期套利空間壓縮削弱了持債誘因，但亞洲與中東資金仍持續增配，不應解讀為市場一致看空。
安邦智庫研究員魏宏旭指出，部分新興市場遭遇賣壓，反映市場對本幣匯率承壓、通膨及潛在升息的疑慮；除了利差之外，貨幣穩定性與整體經濟前景也是決定債券吸引力的核心考量。
paras_en: According to data from regulators and the bond market association, foreign investors switched from buying to selling Asian bonds in August, marking the first net outflow in a single month in five months and breaking the pattern of continuous inflows into the Asian bond market in previous months.

Foreign investors sold a total of $457 million worth of bonds in the markets of South Korea, Malaysia, India, Indonesia and Thailand, with South Korea experiencing the largest outflow of about $5.4 billion in the month, ending a four‑month streak of net purchases. This trend contrasts sharply with the massive net inflow of $11.51 billion into Asian bonds in June.

Market data shows that the shift in capital is directly linked to the surge in U.S. Treasury yields, with the 10‑year Treasury yield briefly breaking above 5%, a near‑20‑year high, and expectations that major central banks will keep rates high, greatly eroding the relative yield advantage of Asian bonds.

Commenting on the capital flow shift, Ni Shuhui, an assistant researcher at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, said that rising yields on U.S. Treasuries and other major developed‑country sovereign bonds have triggered a synchronized global bond sell‑off that has spilled over into Asian markets. However, amid divergent yields across Asian countries, China’s 10‑year sovereign yield of about 1.7% shows better stability and risk‑resilience, and RMB‑denominated bonds still offer diversification and hedging value.

Li Huihui, a professor at EM Lyon Business School, analyzed that the June inflows were essentially a “pro‑cyclical” bet on anticipated rate cuts, while the August outflows represent “profit‑taking” in the face of higher funding costs. Regarding South Korea, she noted that the compression of short‑term arbitrage opportunities has reduced the incentive to hold bonds, but Asian and Middle‑Eastern capital continues to increase allocations, so the move should not be read as a unanimous bearish view on the market.

Wei Hongxu, a researcher at Anbang Think Tank, pointed out that the selling pressure in some emerging markets reflects concerns over local currency depreciation, inflation and the possibility of further rate hikes; beyond yield spreads, currency stability and overall economic outlook are core factors determining the attractiveness of bonds.

items.title: 廣積推單板電腦整合CPU、GPU與NPU 鎖定新世代邊緣AI應用
items.title_en: Giant Integration Launches Single-Board Computer Combining CPU, GPU, and NPU for Next‑Gen Edge AI Applications
paras: 工業電腦廠廣積(8050-TW)宣布，推出高效能IB966 3.5吋單板電腦，搭載Intel Core Ultra 7系列處理器(Panther Lake平台)，於單一平台整合CPU、GPU與NPU運算資源，最高規格配置可提供達180 TOPS的整體AI運算效能，鎖定邊緣端即時AI推理、機器視覺、資料分析及工業自動化等應用場景。

廣積表示，IB966可搭載Intel Core Ultra X7 358H、Intel Core Ultra 7 356H或Intel Core Ultra 7 355處理器，透過異質運算架構依不同工作需求，將運算任務分配至合適的處理單元，加速邊緣端即時決策，同時降低延遲、網路流量及對雲端運算的依賴，並配置雙DDR5-7200 SO-DIMM插槽，最高支援128GB記憶體，可滿足資料密集型邊緣AI應用及高效多工處理需求。
在連接與擴充方面，IB966提供兩組2.5GbE、USB 3.2、USB 2.0及兩組RS232/422/485介面；顯示輸出則支援HDMI、DisplayPort、具備DisplayPort功能的USB Type-C、LVDS及eDP，並配置3個M.2插槽，可支援高速NVMe儲存及無線連線。
此外，IB966支援12V至24V直流電源輸入，並具備數位I/O、Intel AMT主動管理技術、獨立式TPM及可程式化看門狗計時器，強化系統建置的安全性、管理效率及運作可靠性，應用範圍涵蓋機器視覺、智慧製造、智慧交通、醫療影像及智慧零售等高效能邊緣AI場景。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Giant (8050‑TW) announced the high‑performance IB966 3.5‑inch single‑board computer, which uses an Intel Core Ultra 7 series processor (Panther Lake platform) to integrate CPU, GPU and NPU computing resources on a single platform. The top‑end configuration can deliver up to 180 TOPS of total AI compute, targeting edge real‑time AI inference, machine vision, data analytics and industrial automation scenarios.

Giant says the IB966 can be equipped with Intel Core Ultra X7 358H, Intel Core Ultra 7 356H or Intel Core Ultra 7 355 processors. Through a heterogeneous computing architecture, tasks are assigned to the appropriate processing unit according to workload, accelerating edge real‑time decision‑making while reducing latency, network traffic and dependence on cloud computing. The board also features dual DDR5‑7200 SO‑DIMM slots supporting up to 128 GB of memory, meeting the needs of data‑intensive edge AI and high‑efficiency multitasking.

For connectivity and expansion, the IB966 offers two 2.5 GbE ports, USB 3.2, USB 2.0 and two RS232/422/485 interfaces. Display output supports HDMI, DisplayPort, USB‑Type‑C with DisplayPort functionality, LVDS and eDP, and it includes three M.2 slots for high‑speed NVMe storage and wireless modules.

In addition, the IB966 accepts 12 V to 24 V DC power input and includes digital I/O, Intel AMT active management technology, a discrete TPM and a programmable watchdog timer, enhancing system security, management efficiency and operational reliability. Application areas cover machine vision, smart manufacturing, intelligent transportation, medical imaging and smart retail, among other high‑performance edge AI use cases.

items.title: 台鐵攜新光三越打造寶可夢列車 明起至12/13投入西部幹線營運
items.title_en: Taiwan Railways Teams Up with Shin Kong Mitsukoshi to Launch Pokémon Train, Operating on the Western Mainline from Tomorrow Until Dec 13
paras: 為推動鐵道觀光、賦予大眾運輸嶄新活力，台鐵公司今(24)日迎來跨界合作，首度攜手新光三越百貨及The Pokémon Company協助打造的「新光三越周年慶寶可夢30周年主題列車」。台鐵表示，自明(25)日起至今(2026)年12月13日，除了周六、日行駛專列外，也將投入西部幹線各都會區，並安排於各區段表定列車。
本次彩繪專列以台鐵公司EMU800型區間車進行全車包覆設計，外觀集結了歷代經典且深受各年齡層喜愛的寶可夢夥伴，車廂內部更巧妙融入精靈球及冒險元素，讓每一位旅客踏進車廂的瞬間，化身為出發冒險的「寶可夢訓練家」。
新光三越執行副總經理吳昕昌時表示，30周年真的很不容易，回憶起30年前還是中學生，每天回家看寶可夢，沒想到30年後還在追，也成為他與孩子之間重要的交流橋樑，創造許多共同回憶。
吳昕昌表示，此次三方攜手合作並非巧合而是必然，北車也是許多訓練家的「抓寶聖地」，期待大家搭上主題列車，從台北出發展開旅程。
另為配合新光三越百貨於特定期程所開行的主題專列外，此次「寶可夢列車」自明日起至12月13日止，加入台鐵常態營運編組，期間列車將每日穿梭於北、中、南部區間，串連西部路線，為方便鐵道迷與寶可夢粉絲規劃行程搭乘，台鐵將於官網及官方社群公布「寶可夢列車常態運行車次與時刻表」。
paras_en: To promote rail tourism and inject fresh vitality into public transport, Taiwan Railways Administration (TRA) announced today (the 24th) a cross‑industry partnership, debuting the “Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Anniversary Pokémon 30th‑Anniversary Themed Train” created together with Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Department Store and The Pokémon Company. TRA said that from tomorrow (the 25th) through Dec 13, 2026, in addition to special services on Saturdays and Sundays, the train will also run on the Western Mainline through various metropolitan areas and be scheduled on regular services in each segment.

The specially painted train uses TRA’s EMU‑800 series commuter cars with a full‑car wrap design, featuring classic Pokémon partners beloved by all ages. Inside, the compartments cleverly incorporate Poké Balls and adventure motifs, turning every passenger who steps aboard into a “Pokémon Trainer” ready to set off on a quest.

Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Executive Vice President Wu Hsin‑chang said the 30th anniversary is truly hard‑won. He recalled being a middle‑school student 30 years ago, watching Pokémon every day after school, and never imagined he’d still be following it three decades later. Now it serves as an important bridge for communication with his children, creating many shared memories.

Wu added that the three‑way collaboration was not a coincidence but inevitable; Taipei Main Station is also a “Pokémon‑catching hotspot” for many trainers. He looks forward to everyone hopping on the themed train and starting their journey from Taipei.

In addition to the special‑schedule runs tied to Shin Kong Mitsukoshi’s promotional periods, the “Pokémon Train” will be incorporated into TRA’s regular service roster from tomorrow through Dec 13. During this period the train will travel daily across northern, central and southern segments, linking the western corridor. To help rail fans and Pokémon enthusiasts plan their trips, TRA will publish the regular‑operation train numbers and timetables on its official website and social‑media channels.

items.title: 國喬：轉型調整營運策略 鏈結AWI工業氣體布局半導體供應鏈
items.title_en: Guo Qiao: Transforming Operations Strategy and Linking AWI Industrial Gases to Semiconductor Supply Chain
paras: 面對今(2026)年高油價及全球貿易流向重塑等挑戰，國喬(1312-TW）總經理曾嘉雄今(24)日表示，除了積極調整營運策略，將轉型投資及推動產品高值化列為當前重要工作，除了持續優化本業，也積極布局高科技及半導體材料相關產業，包括今年與日本工業氣體大廠愛沃特株式會社(AWI)策略合作，將成為國喬連結半導體材料供應鏈的重要布局。
曾嘉雄指出，隨著美伊衝突持續、原油供應中斷延長，高油價抑制需求並帶動各國通膨與升息，進一步壓抑消費與企業投資動能，加上中國產能過剩持續外溢，全球產業亦加速整併與產能退出，區域供需結構有望逐步改善目前，目前石化同業也依市場需求及利差變化，彈性調整產線稼動率，以適度承接國內供應缺口。
增佳雄表示，國喬甫於上(8)月宣布攜手AWI拓展台灣半導體材料市場，共同入股特殊氣體製造商宏廣新技，看準AWI長期深耕日本工業氣體市場，產品及服務範圍多元，並持續拓展海外及電子相關事業，布局包括台灣在內的國際市場。
對雙方合作，曾嘉雄強調，合作的價值不僅為單一投資案，更在於結合國喬長期深耕台灣所累積的產業基礎，以及AWI在工業氣體、產品技術與國際市場的經驗，國喬將成為AWI在台灣重要的在地合作夥伴，雙方透過優勢互補，有望為未來在台業務拓展帶來正面效益，成為深化半導體材料市場布局的重要推進動能。
國喬長期投入高值化材料，產品涵蓋生質苯乙烯、低碳足跡氫氣、長鏈及生質基尼龍、尼龍彈性體等，子公司泉州國亨亦持續發展高熔纖維，以及應用於電子產業與汽車領域的聚丙烯產品，此次與AWI深化合作，則是在既有高值化材料布局基礎上，進一步將國際合作延伸至半導體特殊材料供應鏈，持續拓展跨產業轉型的發展空間。
國喬表示，今年上半年合併營收為129.14億元，年增17%，第2季毛利率由負轉正。公司認為，儘管石化產業仍面臨高油價、需求承壓及供給過剩等挑戰，但本業營運已有改善，未來將持續強化產品組合與營運效率，並同步推進高值化產品與策略投資布局。
曾嘉雄說，產業環境正在改變，未來競爭力不能只建立在傳統石化規模，也必須將既有製程、材料與產業經驗轉化為新的價值，未來國喬將透過國際合作與策略投資拓展高科技應用，其中產品端將深化特殊材料、電子化學品及與國內幾大氣體廠的低碳足跡氫氣合作布局，並持續評估跨域合作與全球市場發展機會，提升高值化轉型比重及長期營運韌性。
paras_en: Facing this year’s (2026) high oil prices and the reshaping of global trade flows, Guo Qiao (1312‑TW) General Manager Zeng Jia‑xiong said on the 24th that, besides actively adjusting its operating strategy, the company is prioritizing transformation investments and the up‑grading of its products. In addition to continuously optimizing its core business, it is actively positioning itself in high‑tech and semiconductor material sectors, including a strategic partnership this year with Japan’s major industrial gas firm Air Water Inc. (AWI), which will become a key part of Guo Qiao’s link to the semiconductor material supply chain.

Zeng noted that the ongoing US‑Iran conflict and prolonged disruptions in crude oil supply have pushed oil prices higher, suppressing demand and driving inflation and interest‑rate hikes worldwide. This further dampens consumer spending and corporate investment, while excess capacity in China continues to spill over abroad. Global industries are accelerating consolidation and capacity exits, and regional supply‑demand balances are expected to gradually improve. Accordingly, petrochemical peers are flexibly adjusting line utilization rates based on market demand and margin shifts to modestly fill domestic supply gaps.

Zeng added that Guo Qiao announced in August that it would partner with AWI to expand Taiwan’s semiconductor material market, jointly taking equity in specialty gas maker Hong Guang Xin Ji. The move leverages AWI’s long‑term foothold in Japan’s industrial gas market, its diversified product and service portfolio, and its ongoing expansion into overseas and electronics‑related businesses, targeting international markets including Taiwan.

Regarding the collaboration, Zeng emphasized that its value lies not only in a single investment project but also in combining Guo Qiao’s deep, long‑standing industry foundation in Taiwan with AWI’s expertise in industrial gases, product technology, and international markets. Guo Qiao will become AWI’s important local partner in Taiwan, and through complementary strengths the partnership is expected to generate positive effects for future business expansion in Taiwan and serve as a key driver for deepening the semiconductor material market presence.

Guo Qiao has long invested in high‑value materials, offering products such as bio‑based styrene, low‑carbon‑footprint hydrogen, long‑chain and bio‑based nylon, and nylon elastomers. Its subsidiary Quanzhou Guo Heng continues developing high‑melt fibers and polypropylene products for the electronics and automotive sectors. The deeper cooperation with AWI builds on this high‑value material base, extending international collaboration into the semiconductor specialty material supply chain and further expanding cross‑industry transformation opportunities.

Guo Qiao reported first‑half‑year consolidated revenue of NT$12.914 billion, a 17% year‑over‑year increase, with Q2 gross margin turning positive from a loss. The company believes that although the petrochemical sector still faces challenges from high oil prices, pressured demand and oversupply, its core operations have improved. Going forward, it will continue to strengthen its product portfolio and operational efficiency while simultaneously advancing high‑value product development and strategic investment positioning.

Zeng said the industry environment is changing; future competitiveness can no longer rely solely on traditional petrochemical scale but must convert existing processes, materials, and industry experience into new value. Guo Qiao will expand high‑tech applications through international collaborations and strategic investments, deepening its product line in specialty materials, electronic chemicals, and low‑carbon‑footprint hydrogen partnerships with major domestic gas firms, while continuously evaluating cross‑domain collaborations and global market opportunities to increase the share of high‑value transformation and long‑term operational resilience.

items.title: 鴻海擬出清美國金融科技公司Figure Technology Solutions持股 實現投資利益
items.title_en: Foxconn Plans to Liquidate Its Stake in US Fintech Company Figure Technology Solutions to Realize Investment Gains
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(24)日代子公司HCM International Company公告，董事會決議擬出清持有的美國金融科技公司Figure Technology Solutions(FIGR-US)263.28萬股，處分目的為實現投資利益，實際處分價格及交易總金額將依實際處分價格計算後另行公告。
鴻海指出，截至目前，HCM International持有Figure Technology Solutions普通股263.28萬股，持有金額為8058.43萬美元，持股比例1.18%。Figure Technology Solutions主要提供區塊鏈原生資本市場平台，業務涵蓋房屋淨值貸款、消費信貸、資產代幣化等，並透過Figure Connect、DART等平台提供相關金融服務。
此外，鴻海代子公司Joyspeed Global Cargo (China) Limited公告，董事會決議處分上海印華國際貨運代理有限公司股權，交易總金額為人民幣8600萬元，交易對象為準時達國際供應鏈管理有限公司，雙方為母子公司，處分目的為優化集團股權架構。
而準時達國際供應鏈管理有限公司取得上海印華股權上海印華100%股權後，將對其進行人民幣5.5億元現金增資，兩個交易合計投入人民幣6.36億元，資金來源為自有資金，具體目的為優化集團股權架構及長期投資。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced today, via its subsidiary HCM International Company, that its board has resolved to liquidate its holding of 2,632,800 shares of US fintech firm Figure Technology Solutions (FIGR‑US). The disposal is intended to realize investment gains, and the actual sale price and total transaction amount will be announced separately after the price is determined.

Foxconn noted that, to date, HCM International holds 2,632,800 ordinary shares of Figure Technology Solutions, valued at US$80.5843 million, representing a 1.18% ownership stake. Figure Technology Solutions primarily provides a blockchain‑native capital markets platform, with services covering home‑equity loans, consumer credit, asset tokenization, and offers related financial services through platforms such as Figure Connect and DART.

In addition, Foxconn, on behalf of its subsidiary Joyspeed Global Cargo (China) Limited, announced that its board resolved to dispose of the equity of Shanghai Yinhua International Freight Forwarding Co., Ltd. The total transaction amount is RMB 86 million, with the buyer being Zhongshi Da International Supply Chain Management Co., Ltd., a parent‑subsidiary affiliate. The disposal aims to optimise the group’s equity structure.

After Zhongshi Da International Supply Chain Management Co., Ltd. acquires 100% of Shanghai Yinhua’s equity, it will inject RMB 550 million in cash as a capital increase. The two transactions together involve a total investment of RMB 636 million, funded from its own resources, with the specific purpose of optimising the group’s equity structure and supporting long‑term investment.

items.title: 玉山金首波注資三商壽160億元將到位 現增基準日敲定9/29
items.title_en: E.Sun Financial Announces First NT$16 billion Capital Injection into Sanshang Life, Base Date Set for Sep 29
paras: 玉山金控(2884-TW)代旗下壽險子公司三商美邦人壽今(24)日發布重大訊息，正式公告私募發行普通股之現金增資基準日定於 9 月 29 日。本次現金增資發行總金額為新台幣 160 億元，發行股數為 7.8 億股，每股發行價格約 20.51 元，由母公司玉山金控 100% 全數認購。玉山金董事長黃男州日前表示，明(2027)年將再注資 60 億元，無須向股東伸手拿錢。
玉山金控於今年 9 月 1 日正式合併三商美邦人壽後，隨即啟動資產強化計畫。黃男州先前於法人說明會中明確指出，三商壽併入集團後的首要目標是「Back to Health(恢復健康)」，並規劃於今年與明年合計注資 220 億元，全數由金控現增承擔，無需向外部股東籌資。
隨著今日重訊公布，第一階段 160 億元資金將於 9 月 29 日完成繳納與注資，主要用於增加自有資本、充實營運資金、強化財務結構並提升資本適足率。根據玉山金控規劃，在今年 160 億元資金注入後，預估三商壽年底的 TIS(資本適足)可達 125% 的健康標準；明年預計將再挹注 60 億元，進一步完成資本結構強化。
除了資本面挹注，玉山金控也將從商品結構、銷售通路、數位科技及資產管理四大面向推進改革，帶動壽險業務重回健全成長軌道。
此外，金控整合綜效亦同步推進，公平會已於昨(23)日審查通過玉山金控取得「三商美邦保險代理人」全部股份之結合案，認定該併購對國內保險代理人市場結構影響有限，無顯著限制競爭疑慮，決議不禁止結合。隨著子公司資本與業務通路的陸續整併到位，玉山金控的金控版圖綜效可望加速顯現。
paras_en: E.Sun Financial Holding (2884‑TW) announced on the 24th that its life‑insurance subsidiary Sanshang Meibang Life will conduct a private placement of common stock, setting the cash‑increase base date for September 29. The total amount of the cash increase is NT$160 billion, representing 780 million shares at an issue price of about NT$20.51 per share, fully subscribed by the parent company E.Sun Financial Holding. Chairman Huang Nan‑zhou said a further NT$6 billion will be injected next year, without needing to draw funds from shareholders.

E.Sun Financial Holding formally merged Sanshang Meibang Life on September 1 of this year and immediately launched an asset‑strengthening plan. In a prior corporate briefing, Chairman Huang clarified that the primary goal after integrating Sanshang Life into the group is “Back to Health,” and the group plans to inject a total of NT$22 billion over this year and next, all funded by the holding company’s cash increase, with no external shareholder financing required.

With today’s major announcement, the first‑stage NT$160 billion will be paid and injected by September 29, mainly to boost core capital, replenish operating funds, strengthen the financial structure and improve the capital adequacy ratio. E.Sun Financial Holding projects that after this year’s NT$160 billion injection, Sanshang Life’s TIS (capital adequacy) will reach the healthy 125 % standard by year‑end; a further NT$6 billion is expected next year to further solidify the capital structure.

Beyond capital support, E.Sun Financial Holding will also drive reforms across four key areas – product structure, sales channels, digital technology and asset management – to steer life‑insurance business back onto a sound growth trajectory.

In addition, the holding‑company synergy is being advanced in parallel. The Fair Trade Commission approved on the 23rd the merger whereby E.Sun Financial Holding acquires all shares of “Sanshang Meibang Insurance Agents,” concluding that the acquisition has limited impact on the domestic insurance‑agent market structure and poses no significant competition concerns, thus not prohibiting the combination. As subsidiary capital and distribution channels are progressively integrated, the overall synergy of E.Sun Financial Holding’s financial‑holding map is expected to materialize more quickly.

items.title: 台塑化：向台朔重工斥資3.06億添購生產機械 以因應業務需求
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics Corp.: Invests NT$306 million to Purchase Production Machinery from Taiwan Shuo Heavy Industries to Meet Business Needs
paras: 台塑化(6505-TW)於今(24)日下午於證交所召開重訊，由副總經理暨代理發言人蔡健堂對外說明。蔡健堂表示，台塑化自去(2025) 9月25日起至今日9月24日止，因應業務需求，向台朔重工購置生產用機械設備，總價款約為新台幣3.06億元。
蔡健堂表示，此次向關係人台朔重工購買設備為台塑化公司業務需要，主要購買設備包括地面燃燒塔、換熱器等設備，金額約2.41億元，以及其他零星設備及工程金額約有6,553萬元。
蔡健堂指出，該公告取得資產金額中，有3億688萬9千元中，其中有1億8,615萬1千元已經交由審計委員會及董事會決議通過，1億2,073萬8千元將提報今(2026)年11月5日審計委員會及董事會討論辦理。
此次台塑化交易相對人為台朔重工(股)公司，為台塑化持股1.26%之轉投資公司。
台朔重工的產品與服務項目，包括汽電共生整廠及發電廠設備、自動倉儲、煉油與石化製程設備、重件運輸與吊裝、齒輪減速機與大型精密齒輪、工業用滾輪、裡襯、金屬輥輪電鍍研磨及電解拋光等，為台灣具規模的機械設備製造及整廠統包廠商。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics Corp. (6505‑TW) held a major announcement this afternoon (the 24th) at the Taiwan Stock Exchange, with Deputy General Manager and acting spokesperson Cai Jiantang speaking to the public. Cai said that from September 25, 2025 until today, September 24, the company, in response to business demand, purchased production machinery from Taiwan Shuo Heavy Industries for a total price of about NT$306 million.

Cai explained that the equipment bought from the related party Taiwan Shuo Heavy Industries is needed for Formosa Plastics’ operations and mainly includes ground‑burner towers, heat exchangers and similar items, amounting to roughly NT$241 million, plus additional miscellaneous equipment and engineering services costing about NT$65.53 million.

Cai noted that of the announced asset acquisition amount, NT$300.689 million has been partially approved: NT$186.151 million has already been approved by the Audit Committee and the Board of Directors, while NT$120.738 million will be submitted for discussion by the Audit Committee and Board on November 5, 2026.
The counter‑party in this transaction is Taiwan Shuo Heavy Industries Co., a subsidiary in which Formosa Plastics holds a 1.26 % equity stake.

Taiwan Shuo Heavy Industries’ product and service portfolio includes cogeneration plant and power‑plant equipment, automated warehousing, refinery and petrochemical process equipment, heavy‑load transport and lifting, gear reducers and large precision gears, industrial rollers, liners, metal rollers with plating, grinding and electropolishing, making it one of Taiwan’s sizable manufacturers and turnkey suppliers of mechanical equipment.

items.title: 〈工資審議〉GDP狂飆薪水卻跟不上？勞長曝關鍵：AI成長紅利並非人人都吃得到
items.title_en: <Wage Review> GDP Soars but Salaries Lag? Labor Minister Reveals Key Issue: AI Growth Benefits Aren’t Reaching Everyone
paras: 台灣今年經濟成長率預估飆上11.05%，但最低工資調幅卻不到5%，「GDP大增、薪資為何沒跟上」成為今年低工資審議最大攻防焦點。最低工資審議會今（24）日歷經約7.5小時協商，拍板2027年起月薪由29,500元調升至30,900元，增加1,400元、調幅4.745%，時薪則由196元提高至205元，最低月薪首度突破3萬元。
為何GDP成長11.05%，最低工資卻只漲4.745%？勞動部長洪申翰會後直指關鍵在於「產業差異」。今年經濟高速成長主要由AI、高科技及半導體等產業拉動，但傳統產業、服務業及中小微企業並未同步享受到相同成長紅利，最低工資若直接與GDP增幅掛鉤，恐加重部分企業的人事成本負擔。
這也使今年審議出現明顯拉鋸。勞方主張經濟成長成果應由勞資共享，會前甚至提出調幅7.77%；資方則強調產業景氣呈現分化，傳產及中小企業承壓，最低工資不能只看漂亮的總體經濟數字。到了最後階段，勞方喊價31,100元、資方守在30,700元，雙方為400元僵持約40分鐘，最終收斂在30,900元。
另一項考量則是通膨。洪申翰指出，消費者物價指數（CPI）應充分反映，幾乎是審議委員共識；至於GDP成長成果該如何分享，則因產業景氣景氣的冷熱不均，成為會議中各方爭執討論最久的部分。
雖然4.745%明顯低於11.05%的GDP成長率，但此次月薪一次增加1,400元，仍創歷來單次調升金額新高。洪申翰解釋，現階段最低工資基期已高於過去，即使百分比增幅沒有突破5%，換算後的實際加薪金額仍高於歷年。此次調整預估共有261.16萬名勞工受惠，其中本國勞工219.72萬人、移工約41.44萬人。
值得注意的是，最低工資上漲也將增加中小企業、傳產及服務業成本壓力。經濟部長龔明鑫先前亦表示，將與勞動部研商產業配套，考慮比照過去受疫情衝擊產業的補貼模式，並研議將適用範圍由製造業擴大至服務業。
若後續經行政院核定，台灣最低工資將迎來連續11年調漲。不過，在AI與半導體推升GDP突破兩位數之際，最低工資僅成長4.745%，也凸顯台灣這波經濟榮景背後的產業K型分化，以及「GDP成長能否真正轉化為全民薪資成長」，仍將是接下來勞動政策的核心課題。
paras_en: Taiwan's economic growth rate is projected to surge to 11.05% this year, yet the minimum wage increase is under 5%. The question of "GDP booming, why wages aren’t keeping pace" has become the central battleground of this year’s low‑wage review. After about 7.5 hours of negotiations, the minimum‑wage committee voted on the 24th to raise the monthly salary from NT$29,500 to NT$30,900 starting in 2027 – an increase of NT$1,400 or 4.745% – and the hourly wage from NT$196 to NT$205, pushing the monthly minimum above NT$30,000 for the first time.

Why does a GDP growth of 11.05% translate into only a 4.745% rise in the minimum wage? Labor Minister Hong Shen‑han said after the meeting that the key lies in "industry differences." This year’s rapid growth is driven mainly by AI, high‑tech and semiconductor sectors, while traditional industries, services and small‑and‑medium enterprises have not shared the same growth dividend. Tying the minimum wage directly to GDP growth could burden some firms with higher labor costs.

This divergence created a clear tug‑of‑war in the review. Labor representatives argued that the fruits of economic growth should be shared between labor and capital, even proposing a 7.77% increase before the meeting. Employers stressed that industry performance is uneven, with traditional sectors and SMEs under pressure, and that the minimum wage cannot be set solely by attractive macro‑economic figures. In the final round, labor demanded NT$31,100, employers held at NT$30,700, a NT$400 gap that lasted about 40 minutes before both sides settled on NT$30,900.

Another consideration was inflation. Hong noted that the consumer price index (CPI) should be fully reflected – a point on which the committee members largely agreed. How the GDP growth dividend should be shared, however, sparked the longest debate, given the uneven heat and cold across industries.

Although the 4.745% rise is far below the 11.05% GDP growth, the one‑time NT$1,400 monthly increase sets a new record for the highest single adjustment amount. Hong explained that the current baseline for the minimum wage is already higher than in the past, so even without a 5% percentage jump, the real‑term raise is larger than in previous years. The adjustment is expected to benefit 2.6116 million workers, including 2.1972 million domestic workers and about 414,400 migrant workers.

It is noteworthy that the higher minimum wage will also raise cost pressures on SMEs, traditional industries and the service sector. Economic Affairs Minister Gong Ming‑xin previously said the Ministry of Economic Affairs will work with the Labor Ministry on industry‑specific support measures, considering a subsidy model similar to that used for sectors hit by the pandemic and expanding the coverage from manufacturing to services.

If the Executive Yuan approves the proposal, Taiwan’s minimum wage will see its 11th consecutive annual increase. Yet, as AI and semiconductors push GDP growth into double‑digit territory, the modest 4.745% wage rise highlights the K‑shaped industrial divide behind this economic boom and raises the core policy question of whether GDP growth can truly translate into wage growth for all citizens.

items.title: 騰勢IPO上櫃案再闖一關 1-8月營收6.02億元年增10.61%
items.title_en: Tengshi's IPO Listing Application Clears Another Hurdle, Jan‑Aug Revenue Reaches NT$6.02 B, Up 10.61% YoY
paras: 人體及寵物保健食品開發商騰勢 (7889-TW) 營運成長中，其上櫃申請案再過一關，今(24)日並獲OTC董監聯席會通過，騰勢最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收6967萬元，月減5.49%，年減1.36%，2026年1-8月營收6.02億元，年增10.61%。
目前股本2.07億元的騰勢，在2026年1-6月財報顯示，上半年稅後純益4587萬元，每股純益2.24元。
騰勢整體營運呈現「多品牌分層成長」健全格局，主力品牌持續發揮規模效應並維持穩定營收規模放大，而新興培育品牌則迎來的業績成長，為整體營收挹注良好的成長動能。
騰勢指出，1-8月營收年增率正成長，主要受惠於旗下保健品牌「達摩本草」、「毛孩時代」維持穩健成長，且於官網、酷澎、蝦皮、寵物公園等之數位電商及實體通路齊步成長，尤其在關節/骨骼品類業績表現亮眼。
騰勢除了旗下主力品牌穩定放大營收規模的基本盤外，精準保健與精緻寵物市場的佈局迎來成果收割期，日系的機能調理新品牌「大島生醫」及適口性切入的寵物生醫品牌「奧沛」，兩大新興品牌8月份業績展現年增率高達三位數的成長態勢，堆疊騰勢今年整體營收展現良好的成績。
面對台灣電商市場進入成熟競爭階段，傳統流量紅利消退，平台成長動能與獲利模式正加速面臨轉型壓力，導入 AI 技術進行精準行銷已成勝出關鍵。騰勢指出，公司近年來憑藉深厚且成熟的電商操作經驗為基石，全面引進 CDP 顧客數據平台與 AI 自動化行銷工具，深度整合會員消費軌跡。
騰勢透過 AI 演算法大數據分析，官網上今年累積年增2倍 會員的消費能量，公司能精準預測消費者的回購週期與潛在需求，並有效減少無效廣告投放，將行銷資源精準集中於「高轉換率、高客單價」的明星產品組合。這套 AI 精準行銷策略不僅顯著提升了廣告 ROI 與會員忠誠度，更直接轉化為強勁的銷售動能，推升官網等數位電商通路的業績持續放量，不僅帶動達摩本草、大島生醫、優固倍等旗艦品牌營收屢創新高。
騰勢2026年1-8月營收來自電商平台的營收明顯年增19.98%，展現出高度效益化的科技電商實力。
paras_en: Human and pet health supplement developer Tengshi (7889‑TW) is experiencing operational growth, and its OTC listing application has cleared another hurdle, receiving approval from the OTC Board and Supervisory Joint Meeting today (24th). The latest revenue figures show that August 2026 revenue was NT$69.67 million, down 5.49% month‑over‑month and 1.36% year‑over‑year, while revenue for January‑August 2026 totaled NT$6.02 billion, up 10.61% year‑over‑year.
With a current share capital of NT$2.07 billion, Tengshi's financial report for the first half of 2026 shows a net profit after tax of NT$45.87 million, or NT$2.24 earnings per share.

Tengshi's overall operations exhibit a "multi‑brand tiered growth" model. Its core brands continue to leverage scale effects and maintain stable revenue expansion, while emerging cultivated brands are delivering performance growth that injects strong momentum into total revenue.

The company notes that the year‑over‑year revenue growth for January‑August is driven mainly by its health brands "Damo Herbal" and "Mao Hai Era," which posted steady growth across both digital channels (official website, Ku Peng, Shopee, Pet Park) and physical retail, with particularly strong performance in the joint/bone health category.

Beyond the solid base of its core brands, Tengshi's strategic focus on precision health and premium pet markets is entering a harvest phase. The Japanese functional‑care brand "Oshima Biotech" and the palatable pet biotech brand "Aopei" both recorded triple‑digit year‑over‑year growth in August, stacking onto Tengshi's overall strong revenue results for the year.

Facing a mature and competitive Taiwanese e‑commerce market where traditional traffic dividends are fading, platform growth momentum and profit models are under rapid transformation pressure. Implementing AI‑driven precision marketing has become a key success factor. Tengshi says that, building on its deep and mature e‑commerce expertise, it has fully adopted a CDP customer‑data platform and AI automation marketing tools to deeply integrate member purchase journeys.

Through AI algorithms and big‑data analysis, Tengshi has doubled the purchasing power of members on its official website this year. The company can accurately predict consumers' repurchase cycles and latent needs, reducing ineffective ad spend and concentrating marketing resources on "high‑conversion, high‑ticket‑price" star product portfolios. This AI‑driven precision marketing strategy has markedly improved ad ROI and member loyalty, directly translating into strong sales momentum that continues to lift performance across digital channels, driving flagship brands such as Damo Herbal, Oshima Biotech, and Yougu Bei to record‑high revenues.

Revenue from e‑commerce platforms accounted for a clear 19.98% year‑over‑year increase in Tengshi's January‑August 2026 sales, demonstrating the highly efficient, technology‑enabled e‑commerce capability.

items.title: 習近平要求川普「反對台灣獨立」 再提「修昔底德陷阱」
items.title_en: Xi Jinping Urges Trump to “Oppose Taiwan Independence” and Raises “Thucydides Trap” Again
paras: 美國總統川普週四 (24 日) 盛讚他與中國國家主席習近平建立的「真正深厚的友誼」。習近平展開備受矚目的國是訪問之際，則呼籲全球兩大經濟體更緊密合作，避免在競爭中產生摩擦。習近平於會談中要求川普「審慎處理台灣問題」，並再提「修昔底德陷阱」。
川普有許多棘手議題要與這位美國最大經濟競爭對手的領導人討論，但兩人在幕僚陪同下、於正式會談前發表開場談話時，他著重談及自己與習近平長年的關係。
川普說：「自從我 2016 年首次當選以來，習主席與我建立了友誼。事實上，那是一段真正深厚的友誼，建立在相互尊重，以及兩國人民切身利益的基礎上。」
中國迄今未接受川普政府的敦促及經濟施壓，運用自身影響力促使伊朗同意美方提出的停戰條件。這場戰爭已持續近 7 個月。習近平則希望川普永久停止對台軍售，並放寬先進晶片出口限制。雙方週三同意，將原定 11 月 10 日到期、為期 1 年的貿易休戰延長 2 個月，同時尋求更持久的協議。
習近平向川普提台灣議題
據中國官媒《新華社》報導，習近平在閉門會談中也要求川普「審慎處理台灣問題」，敦促美國正式「反對」台灣獨立。
習近平強調，中方維護國家統一和領土完整的立場很清楚。希望美方堅持反對「台獨」的正確立場，慎重處理台灣問題，為美中戰略合作與兩國關係發展奠定堅實基礎。
中國多次要求華府永久停止對台軍售，包括川普與習近平今年 5 月在北京會面時。那次會面後，川普表示，他暫緩最終批准一項正在推進、規模達 140 億美元的軍售案；他也將對台軍售形容為與中國談判時「非常好的籌碼」。
習近平再提「修昔底德陷阱」
習近平指出，美中建設性戰略穩定關係的新定位反映了美中關係的現實，也體現了對未來的期許，是邁向兩國正確相處之道的重要一步。雙方要把這個願景轉化為行動，開創中美關係更穩定、健康、永續的未來。
習近平公開發言的措辭比川普更為直接。他說，美中兩國利益「深度交融」，競爭應該是良性的、有界線的，應該是你追我趕的賽跑，而不是你輸我贏的角斗。
他再次警告，美中必須避免「修昔底德陷阱」，兩國軍隊要維持常態化對話，完善危機溝通和預防機制。川普今年 5 月訪問北京時，習近平也曾提出類似警告。
「修昔底德陷阱」概念指的是，當崛起中的強權威脅取代既有強權時，雙方往往可能走向戰爭。
習近平還宣布，中國將在未來 5 年邀請 10 萬名美國青年赴中學習、交流，並向亞特蘭大動物園贈送兩隻貓熊「平平」與「福雙」。他稱貓熊為「中美兩國人民友誼的使者」，表示牠們將在「幾天內」與美國民眾見面。
習近平：AI 應始終處於人類控制之下
川普週四稍早在社群媒體發文表示，人工智慧將是會談的主要議題之一。他試圖將這項技術重新稱為「超級智慧」。全球對 AI 可能取代工作，甚至危及人類存續的憂慮正持續升高。
川普寫道：「我希望讓它維持現狀。中國的立場也是如此。」
習近平在開場談話中也提到 AI，表示兩國有責任確保 AI 始終由人類掌控。
習近平說：「我們有能力，也有責任為善而發展、管理人工智慧，確保人工智慧的發展始終處於人類控制之下，並造福人民。」
美中財長本週稍早曾會面，美方提議建立兩國之間的 AI 事故「通報機制」。
談及中東局勢
習近平指出，中方一直認為，各國的主權和安全都要受到尊重，始終在為緩局降溫發揮建設性作用，鼓勵各方堅持和平選擇，保持談判動能。
中方支持美伊兩國回歸伊斯蘭堡諒解備忘錄，希望雙方盡早重回對話談判解決問題的軌道，最終達成包括核問題在內的全面協議，盡早實現和平
川普高規格接待習近平 引發部分盟友批評
川普已表明，他希望這次訪問能讓習近平留下深刻印象。他確保白宮南草坪的新直升機停機坪在訪問前完工；週三晚間，習近平與夫人彭麗媛飛抵華府附近的安德魯斯聯合基地時，川普也到場迎接。
白宮安排了隆重的閱兵儀式，供兩國領導人與配偶在橢圓形辦公室會談前觀禮。儀式結束後，第一夫人梅蘭妮亞 (Melania Trump) 陪同習近平夫人彭麗媛參觀史密森尼國家亞洲藝術博物館。
會談約 90 分鐘後，川普與習近平來到南草坪。川普帶習近平參觀新的白宮直升機停機坪與總統直升機「陸戰隊一號」。兩人似乎也從遠處觀看宴會廳工地。習近平在簡短參觀後離開白宮，預定晚間返回出席國宴。
川普在參觀後簡短向記者表示：「我們談得很好。」
兩國領導人稍晚將在白宮東廳出席正式晚宴，餐點包括鱸魚。晚宴採紅色布置，並將舉杯紀念已故總統尼克森。尼克森 1972 年訪問中國，促成兩國於 1979 年建交；美國也在同一時期與台灣斷絕正式外交關係。
川普高規格接待習近平的決定，招致兩黨國會議員及部分白宮盟友批評。
密西西比州共和黨參議員Roger Wicker 說：「坦白說，如果白宮徵詢意見，考量到美方與習近平主席及中國共產黨之間存在的種種令人憂心的問題，我會建議川普總統不要邀請習近平到華府，接受如此隆重的接待。」
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday (the 24th) lavishly praised the "genuine deep friendship" he has built with Chinese President Xi Jinping. As Xi embarked on his highly watched state visit, he called for tighter cooperation between the world’s two largest economies to avoid frictions in competition. During their talks, Xi asked Trump to "handle the Taiwan issue prudently" and again warned of the "Thucydides Trap."

Trump has many thorny issues to discuss with the leader of America’s biggest economic rival, but before the formal meeting, both leaders, accompanied by their staff, delivered opening remarks that focused on Trump’s long‑standing relationship with Xi.

Trump said: "Since I was first elected in 2016, President Xi and I have built a friendship. In fact, it is a truly deep friendship founded on mutual respect and the vital interests of our two peoples."

China has so far not yielded to the Trump administration’s pressure and economic coercion, using its influence to get Iran to accept the cease‑fire terms proposed by the United States. The war has now lasted nearly seven months. Xi hopes Trump will permanently halt arms sales to Taiwan and ease restrictions on advanced chip exports. The two sides agreed on Wednesday to extend the one‑year trade truce, originally set to expire on November 10, by two months while seeking a more durable agreement.
Xi Jinping raised the Taiwan issue with Trump
According to China’s state news agency Xinhua, Xi asked Trump in a closed‑door meeting to "handle the Taiwan issue prudently" and urged the United States to formally "oppose" Taiwan independence.

Xi stressed that China’s stance on safeguarding national unity and territorial integrity is crystal clear. He hopes the U.S. will stick to the correct position of opposing "Taiwan independence," handle the Taiwan issue carefully, and lay a solid foundation for strategic U.S.–China cooperation and the development of bilateral relations.

China has repeatedly asked Washington to permanently stop arms sales to Taiwan, including during Trump’s May meeting with Xi in Beijing. After that meeting, Trump said he was postponing final approval of a $14 billion arms deal that was moving forward; he also described U.S. arms sales to Taiwan as a "very good bargaining chip" in negotiations with China.
Xi Jinping again raised the "Thucydides Trap"

Xi pointed out that the new positioning of a constructive, strategically stable U.S.–China relationship reflects the reality of the bilateral ties and embodies hopes for the future. It is an important step toward a proper way for the two countries to get along. Both sides must turn this vision into action and forge a more stable, healthy, and sustainable future for U.S.–China relations.

Xi’s public language was even more direct than Trump’s. He said the interests of the United States and China are "deeply intertwined," competition should be healthy and bounded, like a race where both run, not a gladiatorial bout where one wins and the other loses.

He warned again that the U.S. and China must avoid the "Thucydides Trap," that their militaries should maintain routine dialogue, and that crisis communication and prevention mechanisms need to be improved. When Trump visited Beijing in May, Xi issued a similar warning.
The "Thucydides Trap" concept refers to the tendency for a rising power to threaten an established one, often leading the two toward war.

Xi also announced that China will invite 100,000 American youths to study and exchange in China over the next five years, and will gift the Atlanta Zoo two giant pandas, "Pingping" and "Fushuang." He called the pandas "messengers of friendship between the peoples of China and the United States" and said they will meet the American public "in a few days."
Xi: AI Must Remain Under Human Control

Earlier on Thursday, Trump posted on social media that artificial intelligence would be a major topic of the talks. He tried to rebrand the technology as "super intelligence." Global concerns that AI could replace jobs or even threaten human survival continue to rise.
Trump wrote: "I want to keep it as it is. China’s stance is the same."
Xi also mentioned AI in his opening remarks, saying the two countries have a responsibility to ensure AI always remains under human control.
Xi said: "We have the capability and the responsibility to develop and manage artificial intelligence for good, to keep its development always under human control and to benefit the people."
U.S. and Chinese finance ministers met earlier this week, with the U.S. proposing the creation of an AI‑incident reporting mechanism between the two countries.
Discussing the Middle‑East situation

Xi noted that China has always believed that every nation’s sovereignty and security must be respected, and that China consistently plays a constructive role in de‑escalating tensions, encouraging all parties to choose peace and maintain negotiation momentum.

China supports the U.S. and Iran returning to the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding, hoping both sides will quickly resume dialogue and negotiations to resolve issues, ultimately reaching a comprehensive agreement that includes the nuclear question and achieving peace as soon as possible.
Trump’s high‑profile reception of Xi draws criticism from some allies

Trump has made clear he hopes the visit will leave a lasting impression on Xi. He ensured the new helicopter landing pad on the White House South Lawn was completed before the visit; on Wednesday evening, when Xi and his wife Peng Liyuan arrived at the Andrews Air Force Base near Washington, Trump was on hand to greet them.

The White House staged a grand ceremony for the two leaders and their spouses to watch before their Oval Office meeting. After the ceremony, First Lady Melania Trump escorted Peng Liyuan on a tour of the Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art.

After about a 90‑minute meeting, Trump and Xi walked to the South Lawn. Trump showed Xi the new White House helicopter pad and the presidential helicopter "Marine One." The two also glanced from a distance at the banquet hall construction site. After a brief tour, Xi left the White House, slated to return later that evening for the state dinner.
After the tour, Trump told reporters briefly, "We had a very good talk."

Later, the two leaders will attend a formal dinner in the White House East Room, featuring sea bass. The dinner will be decorated in red and will include a toast to the late President Nixon. Nixon’s 1972 visit to China paved the way for diplomatic relations in 1979; the United States also severed formal diplomatic ties with Taiwan at that time.
Trump’s decision to give Xi a lavish reception has drawn criticism from members of both parties in Congress and some White House allies.

Mississippi Republican Senator Roger Wicker said, "Frankly, if the White House were to consult me, given the many concerning issues between the U.S., President Xi and the Chinese Communist Party, I would advise President Trump not to invite President Xi to Washington and not to give such a grand reception."

items.title: 美參院一票之差否決決議案 川普對伊朗動武權限未受限
items.title_en: U.S. Senate Defeats Resolution by One Vote, Leaving Trump’s Authority to Use Force Against Iran Unrestricted
paras: 美國參議院週四 (24 日) 以 49 票贊成、50 票反對，否決要求川普政府結束對伊朗戰事的決議案。4 名共和黨參議員倒戈、加入民主黨陣營，但多數共和黨人仍支持川普。這項決議案已於 7 月在眾議院過關，參院表決結果也讓國會能否制衡總統戰爭權限，再度成為期中選舉焦點。
決議案要求總統將美軍撤出對伊朗政府及軍方的敵對行動，包括可能投入作戰或占領任務的地面部隊；除非國會正式宣戰，或明確授權對伊朗使用武力。眾議院先前以 214 票對 208 票通過該案。
參院投票大致依政黨立場分歧。肯塔基州共和黨參議員Rand Paul、緬因州參議員Susan Collins、阿拉斯加州參議員Lisa Murkowski，以及北卡羅來納州參議員 Thom Tillis 投下贊成票；賓州民主黨參議員John Fetterman 則是唯一投反對票的民主黨人。
即使參院通過，這項共同決議案也不會送交川普簽署或否決，主要作用是表達國會立場。
推動決議案的民主黨參議員Tim Kaine 強調，美國憲法將宣戰權賦予國會。他表示，國會議員也應聽取受戰爭影響的民眾及軍人家庭的聲音。
伊朗戰事的影響已從戰場延伸至美國民生。報導指出，自美國今年 2 月開始對伊朗發動軍事打擊以來，伊朗在荷姆茲海峽的反擊使當地成為戰區；美國汽油、柴油、肥料與食品價格均已上漲。這場戰爭也已造成 19 名美軍人員死亡。
戰爭的民意支持度同樣對共和黨構成壓力。
《NBC News》近期民調顯示，33% 的登記選民認為伊朗戰爭「值得」，62% 認為「不值得」。在候選人選擇上，57% 的選民表示更可能支持反對戰爭的人選，24% 則持相反立場。
儘管共和黨在參眾兩院的多數議員仍支持川普，部分面臨選戰的共和黨人已改變態度。
《NBC News》指出，密西根州參議員候選人Mike Rogers，以及愛荷華州聯邦眾議員Ashley Hinson，近期都呼籲結束戰爭；兩人先前曾支持川普對伊朗的政策。
川普則持續為戰爭辯護，主張美國必須削弱伊朗，防止其取得核武。
他在聯合國演說中表示，若伊朗政權能在核武保護下發動大規模恐怖攻擊，將構成美國必須面對的威脅。
paras_en: On Thursday, September 24, the U.S. Senate voted 49‑50 to reject a resolution demanding that the Trump administration end hostilities against Iran. Four Republican senators broke ranks and joined Democrats, but most Republicans continued to back Trump. The measure had already passed the House in July, and the Senate vote revived debate over whether Congress can curb the president’s war powers ahead of the midterm elections.

The resolution called for the president to withdraw U.S. forces from hostile actions against the Iranian government and military, including any ground troops that might be deployed for combat or occupation, unless Congress formally declares war or explicitly authorizes the use of force against Iran. The House had approved the bill 214‑208.

Senate voting largely fell along party lines. Republican senators Rand Paul of Kentucky, Susan Collins of Maine, Lisa Murkowski of Alaska, and Thom Tillis of North Carolina voted in favor; Democratic senator John Fetterman of Pennsylvania was the sole Democrat to vote against it.
Even if the Senate had passed it, the joint resolution would not have been sent to Trump for signature or veto; its primary purpose is to express Congress’s position.

Democratic senator Tim Kaine, who championed the resolution, stressed that the Constitution grants the power to declare war to Congress. He said members of Congress should also listen to the voices of citizens and military families affected by the war.

The impact of the Iran conflict has spilled over into everyday American life. Reports note that since the United States began striking Iran in February, Iranian retaliation in the Strait of Hormuz has turned the area into a combat zone, and U.S. gasoline, diesel, fertilizer and food prices have all risen. The war has also claimed the lives of 19 U.S. service members.
Public support for the war is also putting pressure on Republicans.

A recent NBC News poll shows that 33 % of registered voters think the war with Iran is “worth it,” while 62 % say it is “not worth it.” When asked about candidate preferences, 57 % say they are more likely to support a candidate who opposes the war, compared with 24 % who would favor a pro‑war candidate.
Although Republicans still hold majorities in both chambers and many continue to back Trump, some GOP office‑seekers have begun to shift their stance.

NBC News reported that Michigan Senate candidate Mike Rogers and Iowa Representative Ashley Hinson have recently called for an end to the war, even though both previously supported Trump’s policy toward Iran.
Trump has continued to defend the war, arguing that the United States must weaken Iran to prevent it from acquiring nuclear weapons.

In a speech to the United Nations, he warned that if the Iranian regime were able to launch a large‑scale terrorist attack under the protection of nuclear weapons, it would pose a threat the United States must confront.

items.title: 小摩調升Meta目標價 看好Muse成ChatGPT後最普及AI應用
items.title_en: JPMorgan Raises Meta Target Price, Sees Muse as the Most Widely Used AI Application Since ChatGPT
paras: Meta(META-US) 新推出的 AI 智能體 Muse 本週帶動科技股上漲。該公司週三(23日)晚間在 Connect 大會展示新產品後，獲摩根大通調高目標價。
Doug Anmuth 領導的摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 分析師團隊將 Meta 目標價從 820 美元調升至 920 美元。Meta 股價過去一個月已上漲 30%。
摩根大通看好 Muse，認為它有望成為 ChatGPT 問世以來使用最廣泛的消費級 AI 應用。
Meta 週三晚間表示，Muse 現已可透過連接器與沃爾瑪(WMT-US) 、百思買(BBY-US) 、絲芙蘭及 Wayfair(W-US) 的服務串接；值得注意的是，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 禁止 Muse 存取其商店。
摩根大通分析師表示，隨著時間推進，Meta 應能透過分潤比例或佣金模式，將此類銷售模式變現。
Brian Nowak 領導的摩根士丹利(MS-US) 分析師團隊則維持 Meta 目標價 775 美元。他們表示，Meta 推出的新款眼鏡更輕、更不笨重，可能終於在虛擬實境眼鏡上取得突破。
分析師指出，儘管他們和多數投資人近年對 Meta 的擴增實境及虛擬實境業務抱持懷疑態度，這款產品在體積與功能上確實有明顯進步，值得關注能否成為 2027 年股價進一步上漲的動力；目前 Meta 股價尚未反映這項業務成功的可能性。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) launched its new AI assistant Muse this week, boosting tech stocks. After the company showcased the product at the Connect conference on Wednesday night (the 23rd), JPMorgan upgraded its target price.
Analysts led by Doug Anmuth at JPMorgan (JPM-US) lifted Meta’s target price from $820 to $920. Meta’s share price has risen 30% over the past month.
JPMorgan is optimistic about Muse, believing it could become the most widely used consumer‑grade AI application since the debut of ChatGPT.

Meta said Wednesday night that Muse is now available through connectors to Walmart (WMT-US), Best Buy (BBY-US), Sephora and Wayfair (W-US); notably, Amazon (AMZN-US) has blocked Muse from accessing its store.
JPMorgan analysts noted that, over time, Meta could monetize this sales model via revenue‑share or commission structures.

Brian Nowak’s team at Morgan Stanley (MS-US) kept Meta’s target price at $775, saying the new glasses are lighter and less bulky, potentially finally delivering a breakthrough in virtual‑reality headsets.

Analysts pointed out that, although they and most investors have been skeptical of Meta’s AR and VR businesses in recent years, this product shows clear improvements in size and functionality and could be a catalyst for further stock gains in 2027; the current share price does not yet reflect that upside potential.

items.title: 債券也能賺得像股票 前雷曼交易員驚見「1987年股災前兆」
items.title_en: Bonds Can Yield Like Stocks, Former Lehman Trader Sees ‘1987 Crash Warning’
paras: 前雷曼兄弟交易員麥唐納（Larry McDonald）指出，債券殖利率開始帶來「媲美股票的報酬」，對股市不是好消息。
他在《The David Lin Report》播客節目中表示，當前市場情勢與1987年「黑色星期一」股災前幾個月有相似之處。
麥唐納指出，美股當年於8月見頂，道瓊工業平均指數在該月創下歷史新高，但在短短兩個月後，便創下單日最大跌幅紀錄，跌幅將近23%。
他提到，正是在那個夏天，債券開始提供「媲美股市的報酬率」。回顧1987年，美國10年期公債殖利率一度攀升至9.89%，英國10年期公債殖利率更衝上10.12%。
新冠疫情期間，各國央行將利率降至接近零的水準，促使企業紛紛發行殖利率相對較低的長期債券，例如蘋果發行、將於2060年到期且票面利率僅2.55%的債券。然而，當央行重啟升息循環後，新發行的債券殖利率大幅跳升，迫使舊債券必須折價求售。
他說：「為什麼觀眾現在應該關心這件事？因為債券可能帶來媲美股票的報酬，開始從股市吸走資金。」
以Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 為例，該公司於2026年2月發行了規模達10億英鎊（約13.2億美元）、幾近平價發行的百年期債券。但在夏季過後，其價格跌至原值的87%左右，推動殖利率攀升至7%以上。
他補充說明，甲骨文(ORCL-US) 的長期債券殖利率也出現類似的飆升走勢，落在7%至8%之間。依照以72除以報酬率、估算資金翻倍所需年數的「72法則」，他認為投資約9年就能翻倍。
麥唐納強調，資金能在9年內翻倍就是股票級的報酬，這將開始瓜分股市的資金。
儘管債券若再往下修正一波，將孕育出「絕佳的買點」，但麥唐納也指出，能源價格的狂飆正持續推升經濟衰退的風險。
paras_en: Former Lehman Brothers trader Larry McDonald said bond yields are beginning to deliver "stock‑like returns," which is not good news for equities.
He told The David Lin Report podcast that today’s market conditions resemble the months leading up to the 1987 "Black Monday" crash.

McDonald noted that the U.S. market peaked in August that year, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average hitting an all‑time high, only to suffer its biggest one‑day drop – nearly 23% – just two months later.

He added that it was that summer that bonds started offering "returns comparable to the stock market." In 1987 U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields briefly rose to 9.89% and U.K. 10‑year yields surged to 10.12%.

During the COVID‑19 pandemic, central banks cut rates to near‑zero, prompting companies to issue long‑dated bonds with relatively low yields, such as Apple’s 2.55% coupon bond maturing in 2060. When central banks resumed rate hikes, new‑issue yields jumped, forcing older bonds to be sold at discounts.
He asked, "Why should listeners care now? Because bonds may deliver stock‑like returns and start siphoning capital away from equities."

Using Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) as an example, the company issued a £1 billion (about $1.32 billion) near‑par centennial bond in February 2026, but its price fell to roughly 87% of par after the summer, pushing the yield above 7%.

He added that Oracle’s (ORCL‑US) long‑dated bonds have seen a similar yield surge, landing in the 7%‑8% range. Applying the "Rule of 72" – dividing 72 by the return rate – suggests capital could double in about nine years.
McDonald stressed that a nine‑year doubling of capital is stock‑level performance and will begin to carve out equity funding.
He warned that while another pull‑back in bonds could create a "perfect buying opportunity," soaring energy prices are keeping recession risks elevated.

items.title: AI代理人掀浪潮！Meta Muse跨界衝擊 防禦型股票也難逃
items.title_en: AI Agents Spark a Wave! Meta's Muse Cross‑Industry Impact Makes Defensive Stocks Hard to Escape
paras: Meta Platforms(META-US)本月初推出代理型人工智慧(AI)Muse，把更多決策權交到消費者手中，然而這也讓過去被視為「AI防禦型」的企業與股票面臨新的風險。
不同於單純回答問題的聊天機器人，Muse能根據簡單指令，在用戶只需少量介入的情況下完成一連串任務。根據Cantor Fitzgerald分析師Deepak Mathivanan，Muse在推出初期已展現足以帶動快速普及的好兆頭。
但Muse也引發華爾街擔憂，代理型AI的普及可能衝擊那些仰賴消費者出於習慣或自動扣款，而持續購買產品與服務的企業，也就是高盛分析師所稱的「消費慣性」(consumer inertia)股票。

消費慣性成企業新風險

Muse能執行查詢用戶定期付款、取消訂閱等任務，這項功能可望讓消費者更容易停止不需要的服務，卻可能對那些能從消費者忽略或忘記扣款中獲益的企業造成壓力。
Neostellar Capital負責人Jackson Stone說：「Muse與Instinct等AI代理人，實際上正在降低消費者採取行動的摩擦成本。」面臨顛覆風險的狀況，包括消費者持續支付未使用的訂閱服務、不主動尋找更優惠的價格，或認為取消與轉換服務太麻煩等情況。
因此，可能受到影響的企業包括健身業者Planet Fitness(PLNT-US)、新聞網站《紐約時報》、保險公司Allstate(ALL-US)、串流服務Netflix(NFLX-US)、旅遊訂房平台Tripadvisor，以及報稅軟體公司Intuit(INTU-US)。這些股票周三(23日)再度收黑，延續周二的頹勢。
AI衝擊部分產業的疑慮其實早已存在：依賴網站流量投放廣告的新聞業者，網站流量已見下滑，聊天機器人和Google AI摘要都降低使用者點擊網站的需求，可能進而衝擊廣告業務。
但代理型AI如今可能進一步衝擊過去看似較不容易受到AI影響的產業，例如健身房與串流服務。

AI不只降低取消門檻 也可能刺激消費

不過Stone認為，情況不必然全是負面，原因在於，這些AI代理人不僅能降低取消或轉換服務的摩擦成本，也可能降低購買門檻。
他指出，如果AI代理人能讓消費者從「產生購買意願」到「完成交易」所需的步驟大幅減少，對於能有效承接這類需求的企業而言，可能成為重要的成長動能。
在其他股票因AI代理人衝擊疑慮而下跌之際，Meta股價反而上揚，周三漲1%至每股744.10美元，自Muse本月8日推出以來累計漲幅已達約21%。
paras_en: Meta Platforms (META‑US) launched its agent‑type artificial intelligence (AI) Muse earlier this month, handing more decision‑making power to consumers, but this also exposes companies and stocks previously seen as “AI defensive” to new risks.

Unlike simple question‑answer chatbots, Muse can execute a series of tasks based on simple commands with minimal user involvement. According to Cantor Fitzgerald analyst Deepak Mathivanan, Muse has shown early signs that could drive rapid adoption.

However, Muse has raised Wall Street concerns that the proliferation of agent‑type AI could hit firms that rely on consumers’ habitual or automatic payments to continuously purchase products and services – the “consumer inertia” stocks cited by Goldman Sachs analysts.

Consumer inertia becomes a new corporate risk. Muse can query users’ recurring payments, cancel subscriptions and similar tasks, making it easier for consumers to drop unwanted services, which could pressure companies that profit from consumers overlooking or forgetting charges.

Jackson Stone, head of Neostellar Capital, said: “Muse and other AI agents like Instinct are actually lowering the friction cost for consumers to take action.” The disruption risk includes scenarios where consumers keep paying for unused subscriptions, don’t actively seek better prices, or find canceling and switching services too cumbersome.

Consequently, potentially affected firms include gym operator Planet Fitness (PLNT‑US), news site The New York Times, insurer Allstate (ALL‑US), streaming service Netflix (NFLX‑US), travel‑booking platform Tripadvisor, and tax‑software company Intuit (INTU‑US). These stocks closed lower again on Wednesday the 23rd, extending Tuesday’s decline.
