Concerns that AI could hit certain industries have existed for a while: news outlets that depend on website traffic for advertising have already seen traffic dip, and chatbots and Google AI summaries reduce users’ need to click through sites, potentially hurting ad revenue.
But agent‑type AI may now further affect sectors previously thought less vulnerable to AI, such as gyms and streaming services.
Stone believes the situation isn’t necessarily all negative because these AI agents not only lower the friction of canceling or switching services but could also lower the barrier to purchase.

He notes that if AI agents can dramatically cut the steps from “generating purchase intent” to “completing a transaction,” they could become a significant growth engine for companies that can capture that demand.
While other stocks fell on worries about AI agents, Meta’s share price rose, gaining 1% on Wednesday to $744.10 per share, up about 21% cumulatively since Muse’s launch on the 8th of this month.

items.title: 標普500從未如此依賴兩檔股票 蘋果、輝達權重合計破15%
items.title_en: S&P 500 Has Never Been So Dependent on Two Stocks: Apple and Nvidia Combined Weight Exceeds 15%
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 與輝達(NVDA-US) 對美股的影響力愈來愈大。財務規劃公司 Creative Planning 總裁彼得．馬盧克（Peter Mallouk）指出，標普 500 指數從未像現在這樣集中於兩檔股票。
蘋果與輝達合計占指數權重逾 15%，遠高於網路泡沫破裂前；微軟(MSFT-US) 與奇異(GE-US) 合計占比的 9.1%。
兩家公司股價持續上漲，也推升了它們在標普 500 指數中的權重。蘋果股價週二觸及 345 美元，創歷史新高；隨後美國 10 年期公債殖利率走升、整體股市回落，股價也自高點小幅回檔。
蘋果本月稍早發表 iPhone 18 與首款摺疊手機 Duo 後，股價一路走強，今年以來累計上漲 25%。
輝達則在 8 月下旬表示，下個會計年度業務至少可成長 70%。執行長黃仁勳指出，若沒有供應限制，成長率將超過 100%。輝達股價今年以來累計上漲 21%。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) and Nvidia (NVDA-US) are exerting ever‑greater influence on U.S. equities. Peter Mallouk, president of financial‑planning firm Creative Planning, said the S&P 500 has never been as concentrated in just two stocks as it is now.

Together, Apple and Nvidia account for more than 15% of the index’s weighting—far above the level seen before the dot‑com bust; by contrast, Microsoft (MSFT-US) and General Electric (GE-US) together make up only 9.1%.

Both companies’ share prices have kept climbing, boosting their weights in the S&P 500. Apple hit $345 on Tuesday, a record high; after that, the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield rose and the broader market slipped, pulling Apple’s price back slightly from its peak.
Apple’s stock has been strong since it unveiled the iPhone 18 and its first foldable phone, the Duo, earlier this month, gaining about 25% year‑to‑date.

Nvidia said in late August that its business will grow by at least 70% in the next fiscal year. CEO Jensen Huang noted that without supply constraints, growth could exceed 100%. Nvidia’s shares are up roughly 21% so far this year.

items.title: 美債殖利率飆升 勾起投資人對金融海嘯的痛苦回憶
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Surge, Evoking Investors' Painful Memories of the Financial Crisis
paras: 美國 10 年期公債殖利率再度急升，勾起許多投資人的痛苦回憶。不過，從股市出乎意料的韌性來看，投資人未必願意承認這一點。
美國 10 年期公債殖利率上次升至目前水準是在 2007 年 7 月。三個月後，房市崩盤引發全球金融危機。Bull Theory 團隊指出，那斯達克綜合指數隨後 16 個月重挫 56%。
當然，目前並未發生全球金融危機。僅因殖利率重返 2007 年水準，就斷言股市即將崩盤，那就過於草率。但殖利率走勢值得密切關注，投資人或許也該適度降低股票投資的風險承受程度。
美國 10 年期公債殖利率週三(23日)最高升至 5.12%，創 2007 年以來新高；30 年期公債殖利率觸及 5.44%，5 年期公債殖利率也攀至 2007 年以來高點。
殖利率走高之際，正逢油價上漲且商業活動數據表現優於預期。兩者交織之下，加劇了市場對聯準會進一步升息的擔憂。
聯準會官員的談話也無助於緩解這種焦慮。
紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯（John Williams）週四(24日)表示，為抑制通膨，聯準會可能需要在年底前再度升息，這樣的看法是合理的。他的說法呼應聯準會理事巴爾（Michael Barr）週三的談話；巴爾認為，仍需進一步升息。
paras_en: U.S. 10-year Treasury yields surged again, bringing back painful memories for many investors. However, given the stock market’s unexpected resilience, investors may be reluctant to admit this.

The last time the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield reached its current level was in July 2007. Three months later, the housing market collapse triggered a global financial crisis. Bull Theory notes that the Nasdaq Composite then fell 56% over the next 16 months.

Of course, a global financial crisis is not happening now. It would be premature to claim a market crash is imminent simply because yields have returned to 2007 levels. Still, the yield trend warrants close attention, and investors might consider moderating their equity risk exposure.

On Wednesday (the 23rd), the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield peaked at 5.12%, a high not seen since 2007; the 30-year yield touched 5.44%, and the 5-year yield also climbed to its highest point since 2007.
The rise in yields coincides with higher oil prices and commercial activity data that beat expectations. Together, these factors have heightened market concerns about further Fed rate hikes.
Comments from Federal Reserve officials have done little to ease this anxiety.

Federal Reserve Bank of New York President John Williams said on Thursday (the 24th) that, to curb inflation, the Fed may need to raise rates again before year‑end, a view he called reasonable. His remarks echoed those of Fed Governor Michael Barr on Wednesday, who said further rate hikes are still needed.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉殖利率居高不下持續打擊市場 主要指數下挫
items.title_en: US Stocks Early Session: Persistently High Yields Keep Pressuring the Market, Major Indices Slip
paras: 受到美國公債殖利率持續攀升及國際油價上漲衝擊，市場對聯準會進一步升息的預期大增，美股周四(24日)主要指數大多下跌，道瓊指數下跌0.19%，標普 500 指數下跌0.47%，那斯達克指數下跌0.77%，費半下跌2.09%。
債券市場拋售潮持續，美債30年期殖利率飆升至5.446%，刷新2004年6月以來最高紀錄；指標性10年期美債殖利率亦推升至5.15%，逼近2007年7月以來新高。
殖利率飆升推動了市場對緊縮政策的預期，CME FedWatch 工具顯示，市場預測 Fed 於 10 月升息一碼的機率已從一周前的約 55% 快速上升至 70% 以上，掉期交易甚至已完全反映未來一年可能升息 3 次。
油價成為市場波動的主因之一，布蘭特原油期貨價格突破每桶105美元，西德州WTI原油上漲至每桶約93美元。地緣政治緊張局勢加劇了能源供給擔憂。搭配強勁的美國企業採購經理人指數(PMI)數據，市場擔憂需求與成本端將雙雙推升通膨再起。
周四的重頭戲之一，備受矚目川普與習近平會晤，而中美貿易關係則是各方關注的焦點。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周三表示，全球兩大經濟體已同意將關稅「停火」協議延長兩個月。協議於去年簽署，原定於 11 月到期；它的實施叫停了一場可能顛覆全球經濟成長的針鋒相對的貿易戰。

截至台北時間周四21時許：

道瓊指數下跌98.65點或0.19%，暫報51412.94點
台積電 ADR下跌1.13% 至每股441.89美元
十年期美債殖利率暫持平，至5.12%
紐約輕原油上漲1.67%，至每桶93.70美元
布蘭特原油上漲1.95%，至每桶105.09美元
黃金下跌0.18%，至每盎司4280.04美元

焦點個股：

甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 下跌4.57%，報137.93美元
甲骨文(ORCL-US)已向Blue Owl Capital旗下的開發商 Stack Infrastructure 發出「不可抗力」通知。針對位於美國新墨西哥州、代號為「木星計畫」(Project Jupiter)的超大型 AI 資料中心，甲骨文試圖在項目無法按計畫於 2028 年順利上線時推遲付款，以降低財務風險，而非直接終止租約。
「木星計畫」設計供電容量高達 2.45 吉瓦(GW)，足以提供約 180 萬戶家庭所需電力，是 OpenAI、軟銀(SoftBank)與甲骨文等企業推動高達 4,000 億美元 Stargate AI 基礎設施建設的指標項目。
META(META-US)上漲1.29%，報753.68美元
美國銀行維持 Meta「買入」評級，目標價 810 美元。
美銀認為，META新推出的個人 AI 助手 Muse 為消費級 AI 核心，將全面整合至 Meta 旗下產品與智能眼鏡。
另外，其商業化路徑進一步清晰：串聯沃爾瑪、Shopify 等外部服務，計畫透過交易抽成變現，由廣告拓展至全新交易入口。
星巴克(SBUX-US)持平，報94.14美元
星巴克將於本周關閉美國及加拿大約250家業績不佳的門店，約占其北美門店總數的1%。此舉是執行長Brian Niccol重塑咖啡連鎖業務計畫的一部分。
此次關店行動是繼去年9月宣布的一輪關閉計畫之後的又一舉措，主要針對那些未能達到財務績效要求、或星巴克認為改善空間有限的門店。
paras_en: The market’s expectation of further Fed rate hikes surged as U.S. Treasury yields kept climbing and international oil prices rose, causing most U.S. equity indices to fall on Thursday (the 24th). The Dow slipped 0.19%, the S&P 500 dropped 0.47%, the Nasdaq fell 0.77%, and the FTSE 100 slid 2.09%.
Bond‑market selling continued, with the 30‑year U.S. Treasury yield spiking to 5.446%, the highest since June 2004; the benchmark 10‑year yield also rose to 5.15%, nearing a July 2007 peak.

The surge in yields has fueled expectations of tighter policy. CME’s FedWatch tool shows the probability of a one‑point Fed hike in October has jumped from about 55% a week ago to over 70%, and swap markets now fully price in the possibility of three rate hikes over the next year.

Oil prices were a key driver of volatility, with Brent crude futures breaking above $105 a barrel and West Texas Intermediate climbing to roughly $93 a barrel. Heightened geopolitical tension has amplified concerns over energy supply. Coupled with strong U.S. purchasing‑manager’s index (PMI) data, the market worries that both demand and cost pressures could reignite inflation.

One of Thursday’s headline events was the much‑watched meeting between President Trump and President Xi, with U.S.–China trade relations in the spotlight. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Wednesday that the two major economies have agreed to extend the tariff “cease‑fire” agreement by two months. The pact, signed last year and set to expire in November, has halted a potentially disruptive trade war that could have derailed global growth.
As of about 9 p.m. Taipei time on Thursday, the Dow was down 98.65 points, or 0.19%, at 51,412.94.
The S&P 500 fell 36.33 points, or 0.47%, to 7,669.70.
The Nasdaq dropped 206.73 points, or 0.77%, to 26,729.30.
The FTSE 100 slid 261.71 points, or 2.09%, to 12,272.57.
TSMC ADR fell 1.13% to $441.89 per share.
The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield was flat at 5.12%.
New York light crude rose 1.67% to $93.70 a barrel.
Brent crude rose 1.95% to $105.09 a barrel.
Gold slipped 0.18% to $4,280.04 an ounce.
The U.S. dollar index climbed 0.13% to 101.26.
Focus stocks: Oracle (ORCL‑US) fell 4.57% to $137.93.

Oracle (ORCL‑US) has sent a “force‑majeure” notice to Stack Infrastructure, a developer owned by Blue Owl Capital. Regarding the massive AI data center in New Mexico, code‑named “Project Jupiter,” Oracle is seeking to defer payments if the project cannot be brought online as planned in 2028, aiming to reduce financial risk rather than terminate the lease.

The “Project Jupiter” data center is designed for a power capacity of 2.45 GW—enough to supply roughly 1.8 million households—and is a flagship component of the $400 billion Stargate AI infrastructure effort backed by OpenAI, SoftBank and Oracle.
Meta (META‑US) rose 1.29% to $753.68.
Bank of America maintained a “Buy” rating on Meta with a target price of $810.
BofA believes Meta’s newly launched personal AI assistant Muse is a consumer‑grade AI core that will be fully integrated across Meta’s product suite and its smart‑glasses.

It also sees a clearer commercialization path: linking with Walmart, Shopify and other external services, planning to monetize through transaction fees and expanding beyond advertising into a new commerce gateway.
Starbucks (SBUX‑US) was flat at $94.14.

Starbucks will close about 250 underperforming stores in the U.S. and Canada this week, roughly 1% of its North American footprint, as part of CEO Brian Niccol’s plan to reshape the coffee chain’s business.

The closures follow a previous round announced in September last year and target stores that failed to meet financial performance standards or that Starbucks judged to have limited upside for improvement.

items.title: 「不支持」還不夠！習近平要求川普明確「反對」台獨
items.title_en: "Not Supporting" Is Not Enough! Xi Jinping Demands Trump Explicitly "Oppose" Taiwan Independence
paras: 《彭博》報導，中國國家主席習近平週四 (24 日) 在白宮與美國總統川普舉行峰會時，要求美方正式表明「反對台灣獨立」，這是他迄今要求川普調整對台立場最明確的一次表態。
中國官媒新華社引述習近平表示，美國應「恪守反對台灣獨立的正確立場」，審慎處理台灣問題，為美中戰略合作奠定穩固基礎。
這是川普與習近平首度在白宮舉行峰會，會談時間不到兩小時。中國官媒在發布完整會談內容前，率先公布習近平涉及台灣的談話，凸顯北京將台灣問題列為美中關係中的優先議題。
習近平此次要求美方「反對台灣獨立」，用語比拜登政府過去所稱的「不支持台灣獨立」更為強烈。
曾在拜登及川普政府國家安全會議負責中國與台灣事務的彭博經濟學家 Jennifer Welch 表示，這看似只是語意上的調整，實際影響卻可能相當顯著。
Welch指出，中國可能利用美方措辭變化，削弱台灣對美國支持的信心。「反對台灣獨立」意味美方必須採取更積極的行動，遏制北京所認定的台獨力量，而不只是表明不支持台灣追求正式獨立。
美方若改變措辭，也可能加深外界對台灣成為美中談判籌碼的疑慮。
川普政府已將一項規模 140 億美元的對台軍售案延後數月。川普今年 5 月在北京與習近平會面後，曾形容這項軍售是美國「非常好的談判籌碼」，相關說法引發台灣不安。
北京此次再度要求川普表態之際，也正在調整對台施壓方式。中國一方面減少具挑釁性的軍事行動，另一方面則加強外交孤立，包括向其他國家施壓，阻止總統賴清德的專機飛越其領空。
美國如何描述對台關係，長期以來一直是美中之間的敏感議題。據知情人士先前透露，中國在 2025 年便曾要求川普政府正式宣布「反對台灣獨立」。
美台關係自 1982 年以來，也受到美國前總統雷根提出的「六項保證」影響。相關內容刻意不明確界定台灣主權，但明確表示，美國不會就對台軍售事宜與中國協商，也不會修改要求華府向台灣提供防禦性武器的《台灣關係法》。
川普對台灣的公開立場與前總統拜登有所不同。拜登任內曾表示，如果中國入侵台灣，美國將出兵協防；川普則要求台灣官員提升自我防衛能力。
華府布魯金斯學會中國中心主任 Ryan Hass 表示，習近平正試圖把「建設性戰略穩定」與反對台灣獨立連結。中國官員今年 5 月提出這項說法，作為界定新階段美中關係的概念。
Hass 認為，接下來真正的檢驗標準，是川普將如何表述美國的台灣立場，而不只是習近平要求他接受什麼立場。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Bloomberg reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday (the 24th) at a summit in the White House with U.S. President Donald Trump demanded that the United States formally state its "opposition to Taiwan independence," the clearest request so far for Trump to adjust his Taiwan stance.

China’s state news agency Xinhua quoted Xi as saying the United States should "adhere to the correct position of opposing Taiwan independence," handle the Taiwan issue prudently, and lay a solid foundation for strategic cooperation between the two countries.

This was the first summit between Trump and Xi held at the White House, lasting less than two hours. Before releasing the full meeting transcript, Chinese state media first published Xi’s remarks on Taiwan, highlighting that Beijing is treating the Taiwan issue as a priority in U.S.-China relations.
Xi’s demand that the U.S. "oppose Taiwan independence" uses stronger language than the Biden administration’s previous phrasing of "not supporting Taiwan independence."

Jennifer Welch, a Bloomberg economist who handled China and Taiwan issues for both the Biden and Trump administrations’ National Security Councils, said the change may seem merely semantic but could have a markedly significant impact.

Welch noted that China could use the U.S. wording shift to erode Taiwan’s confidence in American support. "Opposing Taiwan independence" implies the U.S. must take more active steps to curb what Beijing deems separatist forces, not just state a lack of support for formal independence.
If the U.S. changes its phrasing, it could also deepen external doubts that Taiwan is becoming a bargaining chip in U.S.-China negotiations.

The Trump administration has delayed a $14 billion arms sale to Taiwan by several months. After meeting Xi in Beijing in May, Trump described the sale as a "very good negotiating chip" for the United States, a comment that unsettled Taiwan.

As Beijing again pressed Trump for a statement, it is also adjusting its pressure tactics on Taiwan: reducing provocative military actions while intensifying diplomatic isolation, including pressuring other countries to prevent President Lai Ching‑te’s aircraft from overflying its airspace.

How the United States characterises its relationship with Taiwan has long been a sensitive issue in U.S.-China ties. Insiders previously disclosed that China had asked the Trump administration as early as 2025 to formally announce its "opposition to Taiwan independence."

U.S.-Taiwan relations since 1982 have also been shaped by former President Reagan’s "Six Assurances," which deliberately avoid a clear definition of Taiwan’s sovereignty but state unequivocally that the U.S. will not negotiate arms sales to Taiwan with China and will not amend the Taiwan Relations Act that requires Washington to provide defensive weapons to Taiwan.

Trump’s public stance on Taiwan differs from that of former President Biden. Biden said that if China invaded Taiwan, the United States would intervene militarily; Trump, by contrast, urged Taiwanese officials to boost their own self‑defence capabilities.

Ryan Hass, director of the Brookings Institution’s China Center, said Xi is trying to link "constructive strategic stability" with opposition to Taiwan independence. Chinese officials put forward this framing in May as a way to define a new phase of U.S.-China relations.
Hass believes the real test going forward will be how Trump articulates the United States’ Taiwan position, not merely what Xi asks him to adopt.

items.title: 習近平要求川普「反對台灣獨立」 再提「修昔底德陷阱」
items.title_en: Xi Jinping Urges Trump to “Oppose Taiwan Independence” and Raises “Thucydides Trap” Again
paras: 美國總統川普週四 (24 日) 盛讚他與中國國家主席習近平建立的「真正深厚的友誼」。習近平展開備受矚目的國是訪問之際，則呼籲全球兩大經濟體更緊密合作，避免在競爭中產生摩擦。習近平於會談中要求川普「審慎處理台灣問題」，並再提「修昔底德陷阱」。
川普有許多棘手議題要與這位美國最大經濟競爭對手的領導人討論，但兩人在幕僚陪同下、於正式會談前發表開場談話時，他著重談及自己與習近平長年的關係。
川普說：「自從我 2016 年首次當選以來，習主席與我建立了友誼。事實上，那是一段真正深厚的友誼，建立在相互尊重，以及兩國人民切身利益的基礎上。」
中國迄今未接受川普政府的敦促及經濟施壓，運用自身影響力促使伊朗同意美方提出的停戰條件。這場戰爭已持續近 7 個月。習近平則希望川普永久停止對台軍售，並放寬先進晶片出口限制。雙方週三同意，將原定 11 月 10 日到期、為期 1 年的貿易休戰延長 2 個月，同時尋求更持久的協議。
習近平向川普提台灣議題
據中國官媒《新華社》報導，習近平在閉門會談中也要求川普「審慎處理台灣問題」，敦促美國正式「反對」台灣獨立。
習近平強調，中方維護國家統一和領土完整的立場很清楚。希望美方堅持反對「台獨」的正確立場，慎重處理台灣問題，為美中戰略合作與兩國關係發展奠定堅實基礎。
中國多次要求華府永久停止對台軍售，包括川普與習近平今年 5 月在北京會面時。那次會面後，川普表示，他暫緩最終批准一項正在推進、規模達 140 億美元的軍售案；他也將對台軍售形容為與中國談判時「非常好的籌碼」。
習近平再提「修昔底德陷阱」
習近平指出，美中建設性戰略穩定關係的新定位反映了美中關係的現實，也體現了對未來的期許，是邁向兩國正確相處之道的重要一步。雙方要把這個願景轉化為行動，開創中美關係更穩定、健康、永續的未來。
習近平公開發言的措辭比川普更為直接。他說，美中兩國利益「深度交融」，競爭應該是良性的、有界線的，應該是你追我趕的賽跑，而不是你輸我贏的角斗。
他再次警告，美中必須避免「修昔底德陷阱」，兩國軍隊要維持常態化對話，完善危機溝通和預防機制。川普今年 5 月訪問北京時，習近平也曾提出類似警告。
「修昔底德陷阱」概念指的是，當崛起中的強權威脅取代既有強權時，雙方往往可能走向戰爭。
習近平還宣布，中國將在未來 5 年邀請 10 萬名美國青年赴中學習、交流，並向亞特蘭大動物園贈送兩隻貓熊「平平」與「福雙」。他稱貓熊為「中美兩國人民友誼的使者」，表示牠們將在「幾天內」與美國民眾見面。
習近平：AI 應始終處於人類控制之下
川普週四稍早在社群媒體發文表示，人工智慧將是會談的主要議題之一。他試圖將這項技術重新稱為「超級智慧」。全球對 AI 可能取代工作，甚至危及人類存續的憂慮正持續升高。
川普寫道：「我希望讓它維持現狀。中國的立場也是如此。」
習近平在開場談話中也提到 AI，表示兩國有責任確保 AI 始終由人類掌控。
習近平說：「我們有能力，也有責任為善而發展、管理人工智慧，確保人工智慧的發展始終處於人類控制之下，並造福人民。」
美中財長本週稍早曾會面，美方提議建立兩國之間的 AI 事故「通報機制」。
談及中東局勢
習近平指出，中方一直認為，各國的主權和安全都要受到尊重，始終在為緩局降溫發揮建設性作用，鼓勵各方堅持和平選擇，保持談判動能。
中方支持美伊兩國回歸伊斯蘭堡諒解備忘錄，希望雙方盡早重回對話談判解決問題的軌道，最終達成包括核問題在內的全面協議，盡早實現和平
川普高規格接待習近平 引發部分盟友批評
川普已表明，他希望這次訪問能讓習近平留下深刻印象。他確保白宮南草坪的新直升機停機坪在訪問前完工；週三晚間，習近平與夫人彭麗媛飛抵華府附近的安德魯斯聯合基地時，川普也到場迎接。
白宮安排了隆重的閱兵儀式，供兩國領導人與配偶在橢圓形辦公室會談前觀禮。儀式結束後，第一夫人梅蘭妮亞 (Melania Trump) 陪同習近平夫人彭麗媛參觀史密森尼國家亞洲藝術博物館。
會談約 90 分鐘後，川普與習近平來到南草坪。川普帶習近平參觀新的白宮直升機停機坪與總統直升機「陸戰隊一號」。兩人似乎也從遠處觀看宴會廳工地。習近平在簡短參觀後離開白宮，預定晚間返回出席國宴。
川普在參觀後簡短向記者表示：「我們談得很好。」
兩國領導人稍晚將在白宮東廳出席正式晚宴，餐點包括鱸魚。晚宴採紅色布置，並將舉杯紀念已故總統尼克森。尼克森 1972 年訪問中國，促成兩國於 1979 年建交；美國也在同一時期與台灣斷絕正式外交關係。
川普高規格接待習近平的決定，招致兩黨國會議員及部分白宮盟友批評。
密西西比州共和黨參議員Roger Wicker 說：「坦白說，如果白宮徵詢意見，考量到美方與習近平主席及中國共產黨之間存在的種種令人憂心的問題，我會建議川普總統不要邀請習近平到華府，接受如此隆重的接待。」
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday (the 24th) lavishly praised the "genuine deep friendship" he has built with Chinese President Xi Jinping. As Xi embarked on his highly watched state visit, he called for tighter cooperation between the world’s two largest economies to avoid frictions in competition. During their talks, Xi asked Trump to "handle the Taiwan issue prudently" and again warned of the "Thucydides Trap."

Trump has many thorny issues to discuss with the leader of America’s biggest economic rival, but before the formal meeting, both leaders, accompanied by their staff, delivered opening remarks that focused on Trump’s long‑standing relationship with Xi.

Trump said: "Since I was first elected in 2016, President Xi and I have built a friendship. In fact, it is a truly deep friendship founded on mutual respect and the vital interests of our two peoples."

China has so far not yielded to the Trump administration’s pressure and economic coercion, using its influence to get Iran to accept the cease‑fire terms proposed by the United States. The war has now lasted nearly seven months. Xi hopes Trump will permanently halt arms sales to Taiwan and ease restrictions on advanced chip exports. The two sides agreed on Wednesday to extend the one‑year trade truce, originally set to expire on November 10, by two months while seeking a more durable agreement.
Xi Jinping raised the Taiwan issue with Trump
According to China’s state news agency Xinhua, Xi asked Trump in a closed‑door meeting to "handle the Taiwan issue prudently" and urged the United States to formally "oppose" Taiwan independence.

Xi stressed that China’s stance on safeguarding national unity and territorial integrity is crystal clear. He hopes the U.S. will stick to the correct position of opposing "Taiwan independence," handle the Taiwan issue carefully, and lay a solid foundation for strategic U.S.–China cooperation and the development of bilateral relations.

China has repeatedly asked Washington to permanently stop arms sales to Taiwan, including during Trump’s May meeting with Xi in Beijing. After that meeting, Trump said he was postponing final approval of a $14 billion arms deal that was moving forward; he also described U.S. arms sales to Taiwan as a "very good bargaining chip" in negotiations with China.
Xi Jinping again raised the "Thucydides Trap"

Xi pointed out that the new positioning of a constructive, strategically stable U.S.–China relationship reflects the reality of the bilateral ties and embodies hopes for the future. It is an important step toward a proper way for the two countries to get along. Both sides must turn this vision into action and forge a more stable, healthy, and sustainable future for U.S.–China relations.

Xi’s public language was even more direct than Trump’s. He said the interests of the United States and China are "deeply intertwined," competition should be healthy and bounded, like a race where both run, not a gladiatorial bout where one wins and the other loses.

He warned again that the U.S. and China must avoid the "Thucydides Trap," that their militaries should maintain routine dialogue, and that crisis communication and prevention mechanisms need to be improved. When Trump visited Beijing in May, Xi issued a similar warning.
The "Thucydides Trap" concept refers to the tendency for a rising power to threaten an established one, often leading the two toward war.

Xi also announced that China will invite 100,000 American youths to study and exchange in China over the next five years, and will gift the Atlanta Zoo two giant pandas, "Pingping" and "Fushuang." He called the pandas "messengers of friendship between the peoples of China and the United States" and said they will meet the American public "in a few days."
Xi: AI Must Remain Under Human Control

Earlier on Thursday, Trump posted on social media that artificial intelligence would be a major topic of the talks. He tried to rebrand the technology as "super intelligence." Global concerns that AI could replace jobs or even threaten human survival continue to rise.
Trump wrote: "I want to keep it as it is. China’s stance is the same."
Xi also mentioned AI in his opening remarks, saying the two countries have a responsibility to ensure AI always remains under human control.
Xi said: "We have the capability and the responsibility to develop and manage artificial intelligence for good, to keep its development always under human control and to benefit the people."
U.S. and Chinese finance ministers met earlier this week, with the U.S. proposing the creation of an AI‑incident reporting mechanism between the two countries.
Discussing the Middle‑East situation

Xi noted that China has always believed that every nation’s sovereignty and security must be respected, and that China consistently plays a constructive role in de‑escalating tensions, encouraging all parties to choose peace and maintain negotiation momentum.

China supports the U.S. and Iran returning to the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding, hoping both sides will quickly resume dialogue and negotiations to resolve issues, ultimately reaching a comprehensive agreement that includes the nuclear question and achieving peace as soon as possible.
Trump’s high‑profile reception of Xi draws criticism from some allies

Trump has made clear he hopes the visit will leave a lasting impression on Xi. He ensured the new helicopter landing pad on the White House South Lawn was completed before the visit; on Wednesday evening, when Xi and his wife Peng Liyuan arrived at the Andrews Air Force Base near Washington, Trump was on hand to greet them.

The White House staged a grand ceremony for the two leaders and their spouses to watch before their Oval Office meeting. After the ceremony, First Lady Melania Trump escorted Peng Liyuan on a tour of the Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art.

After about a 90‑minute meeting, Trump and Xi walked to the South Lawn. Trump showed Xi the new White House helicopter pad and the presidential helicopter "Marine One." The two also glanced from a distance at the banquet hall construction site. After a brief tour, Xi left the White House, slated to return later that evening for the state dinner.
After the tour, Trump told reporters briefly, "We had a very good talk."

Later, the two leaders will attend a formal dinner in the White House East Room, featuring sea bass. The dinner will be decorated in red and will include a toast to the late President Nixon. Nixon’s 1972 visit to China paved the way for diplomatic relations in 1979; the United States also severed formal diplomatic ties with Taiwan at that time.
Trump’s decision to give Xi a lavish reception has drawn criticism from members of both parties in Congress and some White House allies.

Mississippi Republican Senator Roger Wicker said, "Frankly, if the White House were to consult me, given the many concerning issues between the U.S., President Xi and the Chinese Communist Party, I would advise President Trump not to invite President Xi to Washington and not to give such a grand reception."

items.title: 美參院一票之差否決決議案 川普對伊朗動武權限未受限
items.title_en: U.S. Senate Defeats Resolution by One Vote, Leaving Trump’s Authority to Use Force Against Iran Unrestricted
paras: 美國參議院週四 (24 日) 以 49 票贊成、50 票反對，否決要求川普政府結束對伊朗戰事的決議案。4 名共和黨參議員倒戈、加入民主黨陣營，但多數共和黨人仍支持川普。這項決議案已於 7 月在眾議院過關，參院表決結果也讓國會能否制衡總統戰爭權限，再度成為期中選舉焦點。
決議案要求總統將美軍撤出對伊朗政府及軍方的敵對行動，包括可能投入作戰或占領任務的地面部隊；除非國會正式宣戰，或明確授權對伊朗使用武力。眾議院先前以 214 票對 208 票通過該案。
參院投票大致依政黨立場分歧。肯塔基州共和黨參議員Rand Paul、緬因州參議員Susan Collins、阿拉斯加州參議員Lisa Murkowski，以及北卡羅來納州參議員 Thom Tillis 投下贊成票；賓州民主黨參議員John Fetterman 則是唯一投反對票的民主黨人。
即使參院通過，這項共同決議案也不會送交川普簽署或否決，主要作用是表達國會立場。
推動決議案的民主黨參議員Tim Kaine 強調，美國憲法將宣戰權賦予國會。他表示，國會議員也應聽取受戰爭影響的民眾及軍人家庭的聲音。
伊朗戰事的影響已從戰場延伸至美國民生。報導指出，自美國今年 2 月開始對伊朗發動軍事打擊以來，伊朗在荷姆茲海峽的反擊使當地成為戰區；美國汽油、柴油、肥料與食品價格均已上漲。這場戰爭也已造成 19 名美軍人員死亡。
戰爭的民意支持度同樣對共和黨構成壓力。
《NBC News》近期民調顯示，33% 的登記選民認為伊朗戰爭「值得」，62% 認為「不值得」。在候選人選擇上，57% 的選民表示更可能支持反對戰爭的人選，24% 則持相反立場。
儘管共和黨在參眾兩院的多數議員仍支持川普，部分面臨選戰的共和黨人已改變態度。
《NBC News》指出，密西根州參議員候選人Mike Rogers，以及愛荷華州聯邦眾議員Ashley Hinson，近期都呼籲結束戰爭；兩人先前曾支持川普對伊朗的政策。
川普則持續為戰爭辯護，主張美國必須削弱伊朗，防止其取得核武。
他在聯合國演說中表示，若伊朗政權能在核武保護下發動大規模恐怖攻擊，將構成美國必須面對的威脅。
paras_en: On Thursday, September 24, the U.S. Senate voted 49‑50 to reject a resolution demanding that the Trump administration end hostilities against Iran. Four Republican senators broke ranks and joined Democrats, but most Republicans continued to back Trump. The measure had already passed the House in July, and the Senate vote revived debate over whether Congress can curb the president’s war powers ahead of the midterm elections.

The resolution called for the president to withdraw U.S. forces from hostile actions against the Iranian government and military, including any ground troops that might be deployed for combat or occupation, unless Congress formally declares war or explicitly authorizes the use of force against Iran. The House had approved the bill 214‑208.

Senate voting largely fell along party lines. Republican senators Rand Paul of Kentucky, Susan Collins of Maine, Lisa Murkowski of Alaska, and Thom Tillis of North Carolina voted in favor; Democratic senator John Fetterman of Pennsylvania was the sole Democrat to vote against it.
Even if the Senate had passed it, the joint resolution would not have been sent to Trump for signature or veto; its primary purpose is to express Congress’s position.

Democratic senator Tim Kaine, who championed the resolution, stressed that the Constitution grants the power to declare war to Congress. He said members of Congress should also listen to the voices of citizens and military families affected by the war.

The impact of the Iran conflict has spilled over into everyday American life. Reports note that since the United States began striking Iran in February, Iranian retaliation in the Strait of Hormuz has turned the area into a combat zone, and U.S. gasoline, diesel, fertilizer and food prices have all risen. The war has also claimed the lives of 19 U.S. service members.
Public support for the war is also putting pressure on Republicans.

A recent NBC News poll shows that 33 % of registered voters think the war with Iran is “worth it,” while 62 % say it is “not worth it.” When asked about candidate preferences, 57 % say they are more likely to support a candidate who opposes the war, compared with 24 % who would favor a pro‑war candidate.
Although Republicans still hold majorities in both chambers and many continue to back Trump, some GOP office‑seekers have begun to shift their stance.

NBC News reported that Michigan Senate candidate Mike Rogers and Iowa Representative Ashley Hinson have recently called for an end to the war, even though both previously supported Trump’s policy toward Iran.
Trump has continued to defend the war, arguing that the United States must weaken Iran to prevent it from acquiring nuclear weapons.

In a speech to the United Nations, he warned that if the Iranian regime were able to launch a large‑scale terrorist attack under the protection of nuclear weapons, it would pose a threat the United States must confront.

items.title: 小摩調升Meta目標價 看好Muse成ChatGPT後最普及AI應用
items.title_en: JPMorgan Raises Meta Target Price, Sees Muse as the Most Widely Used AI Application Since ChatGPT
paras: Meta(META-US) 新推出的 AI 智能體 Muse 本週帶動科技股上漲。該公司週三(23日)晚間在 Connect 大會展示新產品後，獲摩根大通調高目標價。
Doug Anmuth 領導的摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 分析師團隊將 Meta 目標價從 820 美元調升至 920 美元。Meta 股價過去一個月已上漲 30%。
摩根大通看好 Muse，認為它有望成為 ChatGPT 問世以來使用最廣泛的消費級 AI 應用。
Meta 週三晚間表示，Muse 現已可透過連接器與沃爾瑪(WMT-US) 、百思買(BBY-US) 、絲芙蘭及 Wayfair(W-US) 的服務串接；值得注意的是，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 禁止 Muse 存取其商店。
摩根大通分析師表示，隨著時間推進，Meta 應能透過分潤比例或佣金模式，將此類銷售模式變現。
Brian Nowak 領導的摩根士丹利(MS-US) 分析師團隊則維持 Meta 目標價 775 美元。他們表示，Meta 推出的新款眼鏡更輕、更不笨重，可能終於在虛擬實境眼鏡上取得突破。
分析師指出，儘管他們和多數投資人近年對 Meta 的擴增實境及虛擬實境業務抱持懷疑態度，這款產品在體積與功能上確實有明顯進步，值得關注能否成為 2027 年股價進一步上漲的動力；目前 Meta 股價尚未反映這項業務成功的可能性。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) launched its new AI assistant Muse this week, boosting tech stocks. After the company showcased the product at the Connect conference on Wednesday night (the 23rd), JPMorgan upgraded its target price.
Analysts led by Doug Anmuth at JPMorgan (JPM-US) lifted Meta’s target price from $820 to $920. Meta’s share price has risen 30% over the past month.
JPMorgan is optimistic about Muse, believing it could become the most widely used consumer‑grade AI application since the debut of ChatGPT.

Meta said Wednesday night that Muse is now available through connectors to Walmart (WMT-US), Best Buy (BBY-US), Sephora and Wayfair (W-US); notably, Amazon (AMZN-US) has blocked Muse from accessing its store.
JPMorgan analysts noted that, over time, Meta could monetize this sales model via revenue‑share or commission structures.

Brian Nowak’s team at Morgan Stanley (MS-US) kept Meta’s target price at $775, saying the new glasses are lighter and less bulky, potentially finally delivering a breakthrough in virtual‑reality headsets.

Analysts pointed out that, although they and most investors have been skeptical of Meta’s AR and VR businesses in recent years, this product shows clear improvements in size and functionality and could be a catalyst for further stock gains in 2027; the current share price does not yet reflect that upside potential.

items.title: 軌道運算｜Google首度將AI晶片送上太空加入太空資料中心競賽
items.title_en: Orbit Computing | Google Sends AI Chip to Space for the First Time, Joining the Space Data Center Race
paras: 2026年09月25日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心用電需求快速攀升，科技巨頭開始尋找地面以外的算力部署方式。Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)週四宣布，Project Suncatcher將於下週首度把自研Tensor Processing Unit(TPU)送入低地球軌道，測試AI晶片能否在太空環境穩定運作。
此次測試由Google與Planet Labs(PL-US)合作，原型衛星將搭乘SpaceX的Transporter-18共乘火箭升空。Google將測試TPU能否承受火箭發射、太空輻射及極端溫度，並蒐集實際在軌數據，找出可能影響AI晶片運作的問題。
其中，輻射與散熱是兩大技術挑戰。太空輻射可能干擾電子元件並造成資料錯誤，而真空環境無法利用傳統空氣對流散熱。Google將採用熱管搭配散熱器，測試高功率TPU產生的熱能能否有效排出。
Google規畫2027年再發射2顆衛星，測試高頻寬雷射通訊，為未來讓多顆衛星共同處理大型AI工作負載做準備。換言之，這次任務仍以硬體驗證為主，距離真正建置太空資料中心仍有一段距離。
Planet Labs在這次任務中主要參與衛星合作。公司本身從事地球觀測衛星與影像數據服務，過去已多次利用SpaceX共乘任務發射衛星，雙方早在2021年便簽署多年、多次發射協議。此次Google加入，也讓既有的衛星製造與發射能力開始延伸至AI運算測試。
Google並非唯一投入太空AI運算的業者。SpaceX與Starcloud也在推動相關計畫，其中SpaceX規畫最快2027年部署AI運算衛星。新創Starcloud則已將輝達Nvidia(NVDA-US) H100 GPU送入低地球軌道，並規畫從單顆測試衛星逐步擴大至衛星星座，長期目標更指向5 GW級太空資料中心。
各家公司看上的共同優勢，是太空可長時間取得太陽能，若技術與成本問題能夠克服，可望降低大型AI運算對地面電網與土地的依賴。
背後最大的推力仍是AI缺電。摩根士丹利Morgan Stanley(MS-US)估計，AI電力需求到2028年可能接近100 GW，相當於目前美國約1,300 GW發電容量的近8%。隨AI資料中心規模朝GW級發展，電網併接及新增發電速度逐漸成為算力擴張的限制。
近期資料中心業者已開始增加燃料電池、天然氣發電及微電網等現場發電方案，Google、SpaceX則進一步探索太空太陽能與衛星運算。兩者反映的是相同問題：AI算力成長速度正超越既有電力基礎設施的擴張速度。
不過，太空資料中心仍面臨發射成本、晶片抗輻射、真空散熱、衛星量產及維修等問題，短期內仍難取代地面資料中心。Google此次首度將TPU送上太空，較重要的意義在於太空AI運算已從概念走向實際測試，後續將觀察2027年雙衛星雷射通訊測試，以及相關技術能否進一步朝大型AI運算發展。

paras_en: September 25, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – As AI data centers’ power demand soars, tech giants are looking for compute deployment beyond Earth’s surface. Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Google’s parent company, announced on Thursday that Project Suncatcher will launch its in‑house Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) into low‑Earth orbit next week to test whether the AI chip can operate stably in space.

The test, a collaboration between Google and Planet Labs (PL-US), will ride on SpaceX’s Transporter‑18 rideshare rocket. Google will assess whether the TPU can survive launch stresses, space radiation and extreme temperatures, and will collect on‑orbit data to identify any issues that could affect AI chip performance.

Radiation and heat dissipation are the two main technical challenges. Space radiation can interfere with electronic components and cause data errors, while the vacuum of space prevents traditional air‑convection cooling. Google will use heat pipes paired with radiators to see if the high‑power TPU’s heat can be effectively expelled.

Google plans to launch two more satellites in 2027 to test high‑bandwidth laser communications, preparing for future constellations that could jointly handle large AI workloads. In other words, this mission is still focused on hardware validation, and a full‑scale space data center remains some way off.

Planet Labs’ role in this mission is primarily satellite partnership. The company, which provides Earth‑observation satellites and imaging data services, has repeatedly launched satellites via SpaceX rideshares and signed a multi‑year, multi‑launch agreement with Google back in 2021. Google’s involvement extends the existing satellite manufacturing and launch capability into AI compute testing.

Google is not the only player pursuing space‑based AI compute. SpaceX and the startup Starcloud are also advancing related projects, with SpaceX aiming to deploy AI compute satellites as early as 2027. Starcloud has already sent an Nvidia (NVDA-US) H100 GPU into low‑Earth orbit and plans to scale from a single test satellite to a full constellation, ultimately targeting a 5‑GW‑class space data center.

All the companies are attracted by the same advantage: space can harvest solar energy continuously. If technical and cost hurdles are overcome, this could reduce reliance on terrestrial power grids and land for large‑scale AI compute.

The biggest driver behind this push is AI’s power shortage. Morgan Stanley (MS-US) estimates AI electricity demand could approach 100 GW by 2028, roughly 8 % of the United States’ current 1,300 GW generation capacity. As AI data centers scale to GW‑level, grid integration and new generation capacity are becoming limiting factors for compute expansion.

Recently, data‑center operators have begun adding on‑site generation such as fuel cells, natural‑gas generators and micro‑grids, while Google and SpaceX are further exploring space solar power and satellite compute. Both reflect the same issue: AI compute growth is outpacing the expansion of existing power infrastructure.

However, space data centers still face challenges like launch costs, radiation‑hard chips, vacuum cooling, satellite mass production and maintenance, making them unlikely to replace ground‑based centers in the short term. Google’s first‑ever TPU flight is significant because space‑based AI compute has moved from concept to actual testing; future observations will focus on the 2027 dual‑satellite laser‑link test and whether the technology can advance toward large‑scale AI workloads.

items.title: 瑞士央行連續五次維持利率0% 軟化干預措辭
items.title_en: Swiss National Bank Keeps Policy Rate at 0% for Fifth Consecutive Meeting, Softens Intervention Language
paras: 瑞士央行周四(24日)宣布將關鍵政策利率維持在0%不變，為連續第五次會議按兵不動，符合市場預期。相較於美國聯準會、歐洲中央銀行與日本銀行等主要貿易夥伴央行相繼啟動升息循環，瑞士央行仍選擇維持利率現狀。
決議公布後，瑞郎兌美元應聲下挫0.3%，報1.2077瑞郎兌1美元；瑞士10年期公債殖利率則持穩於0.57%附近，逼近近期高點。
受中東局勢升溫與國際油價上揚影響，瑞士8月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率回升至0.8%，但仍處於央行0%至2%的物價穩定目標區間內。瑞士央行預測2026年平均通膨率為0.7%，2027年與2028年均為0.8%。
在匯率干預方面，瑞士央行軟化了先前「增加干預意願」的強硬措辭，轉為「必要時於外匯市場採取行動」。
針對政策走向，瑞士央行總裁施萊格爾(Martin Schlegel) 表示，中期的通膨壓力僅微幅上升，當前0%的利率環境依然適當。
施萊格爾指出，先前因伊朗局勢爆發引發避險資金湧入，央行曾強力干預以防瑞郎急升；隨著瑞郎近期走弱，央行策略已轉為按需要調整外匯市場參與。面對國際升息浪潮，他強調：「我們是為瑞士制定貨幣政策。」
瑞銀集團(UBS)經濟學家在研報中指出，自6月會議以來，瑞郎兌歐元貶值逾2%、兌美元貶值逾1%，加上油價高企，大幅提高了央行提前升息的可能性，並提醒「瑞士央行歷來有出乎市場意料的傳統」。
瑞士 HIM 商學院金融學負責人Gedeon Tumong分析，瑞士享有「避險紅利」，境外資金流入支撐瑞郎，降低輸入型通膨；加上瑞士實施嚴格的「財政債務煞車機制」，無須透過提高殖利率來吸引債券投資人，因而得以維持超低利率。
paras_en: The Swiss National Bank announced on Thursday (the 24th) that it will keep its key policy rate unchanged at 0%, marking the fifth consecutive meeting of holding steady and matching market expectations. While major trading partners such as the U.S. Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan have begun cycles of rate hikes, the SNB continues to maintain the current rate level.

After the decision was released, the Swiss franc slipped 0.3% against the U.S. dollar, trading at 1.2077 francs per dollar, and the yield on the 10‑year Swiss government bond held steady around 0.57%, near recent highs.

Affected by the escalation of tensions in the Middle East and rising international oil prices, Switzerland’s August consumer price index (CPI) year‑over‑year rate rose to 0.8%, still within the SNB’s 0%‑2% price‑stability target range. The SNB forecasts an average inflation rate of 0.7% for 2026 and 0.8% for both 2027 and 2028.

Regarding foreign‑exchange intervention, the SNB softened its earlier hard‑line wording of “increasing willingness to intervene” to a more measured “will act in the foreign‑exchange market when necessary.”
On policy direction, SNB President Martin Schlegel said that medium‑term inflation pressures have only risen marginally and that the current 0% rate environment remains appropriate.

Schlegel noted that earlier, after the outbreak of the Iran situation triggered a surge of safe‑haven flows, the central bank intervened forcefully to prevent a sharp appreciation of the franc; with the franc now weakening, the bank’s strategy has shifted to adjusting its market participation as needed. Facing the global wave of rate hikes, he emphasized: “We are setting monetary policy for Switzerland.”

UBS economists wrote in a research note that since the June meeting, the franc has depreciated more than 2% against the euro and over 1% against the dollar. Combined with high oil prices, this significantly raises the likelihood of the SNB raising rates ahead of schedule, and they reminded that “the Swiss National Bank has a tradition of surprising the market.”

Gedeon Tumong, head of finance at the Swiss HIM Business School, analyzed that Switzerland enjoys a “safe‑haven dividend,” with foreign capital inflows supporting the franc and lowering import‑driven inflation. Coupled with Switzerland’s strict “fiscal debt brake” mechanism, there is no need to raise yields to attract bond investors, allowing the country to maintain ultra‑low rates.

items.title: 鷹派立場明確 挪威央行升息1碼至4.5% 宣示對抗通膨決心
items.title_en: Hawkish Stance Clear as Norway's Central Bank Raises Rate by One Tick to 4.5% to Signal Determination Against Inflation
paras: 挪威中央銀行周四(24日)宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，將政策利率調升至4.50%。這是挪威央行今年以來第二度升息，決策結果符合外媒調查多數經濟學家的預期。同日，瑞典稍早宣布將基準利率維持在1.75%不變，這是歐盟最低的利率水準。
挪威央行表示，若有必要已準備好進一步升息，以抑止消費物價上漲壓力。決策公布後，挪威克朗對歐元與瑞典克朗匯率均走強。
挪威央行總裁Ida Wolden Bache在官方聲明中表示：「在一段時間內保持高利率可能是必要的，委員會已做好準備，若有需要將進一步升息，以在合理的時間範圍內將通膨率降至2%的目標。」
他補充說明：「儘管夏季期間的基層通膨率有所放緩且低於預期，但從更長遠的角度來看，通膨前景並未發生重大改變。」
此外，挪威央行政策委員會也發表看法指出：「委員會並不希望對經濟造成過度限制，但認為採取稍微緊縮的貨幣政策立場，是讓通膨率在合理時間內回落至目標值所必需的。」
做為歐洲最大的能源出口國，挪威的核心通膨率在8月達到年增3.0%，雖然低於央行預測的3.3%，但仍持續高於2%的官方通膨目標。《路透》市場調查顯示，28位受訪經濟學家中，有16位準確預測本次升息，多數專家預估4.50%將是本輪升息循環的頂峰。
挪威央行預估，隨著經濟進一步降溫，失業率可能略升至疫情前的水準之上，通膨預計自明年起放緩，並於2029年回落至2%目標。
paras_en: Norway's central bank announced on Thursday (the 24th) a 25‑basis‑point rate hike, lifting the policy rate to 4.50%. This is the second increase this year and matches the expectations of most economists surveyed by foreign media. On the same day, Sweden earlier announced it would keep its benchmark rate unchanged at 1.75%, the lowest level in the EU.

The Norges Bank said it is ready to raise rates further if necessary to curb consumer‑price inflation pressure. After the decision, the Norwegian krone strengthened against both the euro and the Swedish krona.

Governor Ida Wolden Bache said in the official statement: “Keeping rates high for a period may be necessary, and the committee is prepared to raise rates further if needed, to bring inflation down to the 2% target within a reasonable time frame.”
She added: “Although core inflation slowed during the summer and came in below expectations, the longer‑term inflation outlook has not changed significantly.”

The policy committee also noted: “The committee does not want to overly restrict the economy, but believes a slightly tighter monetary stance is necessary for inflation to fall back to the target within a reasonable horizon.”

As Europe’s largest energy exporter, Norway’s core inflation hit an annual 3.0% in August, below the bank’s 3.3% forecast but still well above the 2% official target. A Reuters poll of 28 economists found 16 correctly predicted the hike, and most expect 4.50% to be the peak of this tightening cycle.
The bank projects that as the economy cools further, unemployment may edge slightly above pre‑pandemic levels, inflation is expected to ease from next year and to return to the 2% goal by 2029.

items.title: 〈台幣〉連假前觀望轉貶收31.78元 貶值6.4分
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Turns Slightly Lower Before Holiday, Closing at 31.78, Down 0.064
paras: 新台幣今(24)日雖一度升值，但全日幾乎處在貶值態勢，反映連假前資金流入動能轉趨觀望，終場收在31.78元，貶值6.4分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值略擴大至18.41億美元。
新台幣今日以31.75元、貶值3.4分開出後，一度升至31.71元，但隨後買匯力道加大，最低點來到31.866元，全日高低價差1.56角。
觀察主要亞幣，因國際局勢不確定性大，多呈現狹幅震盪，適逢川習會期間，美元指數在平盤附近震盪，而新台幣收貶0.2%，韓元貶0.2%上下，人民幣和泰銖貶0.1%上下，日元和星元處平盤上下波動。
國泰證期研究部分析，美國 9 月服務業 PMI 升至 58.7、製造業 PMI 升至 56.7，強韌數據引發通膨難降擔憂，市場預期聯準會 10 月續升息 1 碼機率達66%，使美債殖利率再度走高。
不過，由於市場也傳出護國神山台積電(2330-TW)明年1 月調漲先進製程晶圓代工價，為台股下檔提供有力支撐。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar briefly appreciated today (the 24th), but for most of the day it was on a depreciating trend, reflecting that inflows ahead of the holiday turned cautious. It closed at 31.78 per dollar, down 0.064, and the turnover at a Taipei foreign exchange brokerage firm slightly increased to US$1.841 billion.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.75, down 0.034, then rose to 31.71, but as buying pressure increased the low reached 31.866, giving a daily high‑low spread of 0.156 NT$.

Looking at the major Asian currencies, uncertainty in the international situation kept most of them in a narrow range. During the US‑China summit, the US dollar index hovered around the flat line, and the New Taiwan dollar closed down 0.2%, the Korean won down about 0.2%, the Chinese yuan and Thai baht each down about 0.1%, while the Japanese yen and Singapore dollar fluctuated around flat.

The Cathay Securities Research Department analyzed that the US September services PMI rose to 58.7 and the manufacturing PMI to 56.7. The robust data sparked worries that inflation will be hard to bring down, and the market now sees a 66% probability that the Fed will raise rates by one full point in October, pushing US Treasury yields higher again.

However, the market also heard that Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC, 2330‑TW) will raise its advanced‑process wafer foundry prices in January next year, providing strong support for the lower end of the Taiwan stock market.

items.title: 日元再朝160邁進 匯市干預風險升溫
items.title_en: Yen Nears 160 Again, Forex Intervention Risk Rises
paras: 隨著日本假期結束，日元兌美元長達兩週的跌勢令匯率再度逼近 160 心理關卡，市場對日本政府發動外匯干預的戒心顯著增強。
儘管日本央行日前將政策利率升至 1.25%，但因總裁植田和男會後表態不如期待鷹派，加上美國聯準會可能維持緊縮政策，美日利差格局依然頑固，市場普遍對干預能否扭轉貶勢持審慎態度。

160關卡成試金石 多空角力加劇

澳洲聯邦銀行外匯策略師 Carol Kong 指出，若美債殖利率持續上升，且市場繼續測試日本捍衛日元的決心，美元兌日元可能很快突破 160 大關。她強調，考量到先前官方的匯率檢查(Rate Check)及美日協同干預先例，一旦快速衝破該門檻，當局出手干預的機率將大幅提高。
然而，澳洲國民銀行(NAB)外匯策略負責人 Ray Attrill 認為，雖然日元極可能再次探向 160，但「干預警戒感本身或將暫時阻礙其突破」。
Attrill 補充，日本單獨干預的效果通常較為短暫，市場很快會消化其影響，欲實現持續反轉，美國的參與至關重要。若日元重回 160，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)捍衛強勢日元的信念將面臨考驗，美方再次支援的前提可能取決於日本是否展現超越市場預期的升息決心。

基本面不利 單靠干預難治本

金融服務公司 Ebury 市場策略負責人 Matthew Ryan 強調，外匯干預僅是暫時抑壓賣壓的手段，若缺乏強有力的貨幣政策配合，日本當局很難壓制日元走貶。瑞銀資產管理(UBS Asset Management)全球主權與貨幣固定收益主管 Kevin Zhao 甚至表示，若政府干預引發日元短暫反彈，他將視為「逢高賣出日元」的時機。
Zhao 分析，驅動日元疲軟的基本面政策並未改變，日本首相高市早苗維持擴張性財政政策，在巨額國債下偏好低利率環境，且「安倍經濟學並不代表強勢日元」。此外，即使日本央行升息，若聯準會亦同步升息，美日利差便難以收窄，單靠升息無法維持日元強勢。
瑞銀集團策略師 Shahab Jalinoos 等人也在報告中指出，數據顯示投機客先前的日元空頭部位已完全消化，在套利交易環境持續有利且美日利差仍大的背景下，投資人重新建立日元賣壓部位的空間已經打開。
paras_en: As the Japanese holiday ends, the yen's two‑week slide against the dollar has brought the exchange rate close to the psychological 160 level again, heightening market wariness of a possible foreign‑exchange intervention by the Japanese government.

Even though the Bank of Japan recently raised its policy rate to 1.25%, the tone of Governor Kazuo Ueda after the meeting was less hawkish than expected, and with the U.S. Federal Reserve likely to maintain a tight stance, the US‑Japan rate‑differential remains stubborn, leading markets to take a cautious view on whether intervention can reverse the yen's decline.

The 160 threshold is a litmus test, intensifying the tug‑of‑war between bulls and bears. Australian Commonwealth Bank FX strategist Carol Kong notes that if U.S. Treasury yields keep rising and markets continue testing Japan's resolve to defend the yen, the USD/JPY pair could soon break the 160 barrier. She stresses that, given past official rate checks and US‑Japan coordinated‑intervention precedents, a rapid breach would greatly increase the odds of authorities stepping in.
However, NAB FX strategy head Ray Attrill believes that while the yen is very likely to test 160 again, “the very sense of intervention caution itself may temporarily impede its breakthrough.”

Attrill adds that solo Japanese intervention tends to be short‑lived, with markets quickly absorbing its effect; a sustained reversal would require U.S. participation. If the yen returns to 160, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s belief in a strong yen will be tested, and any renewed U.S. support may hinge on Japan showing rate‑hike resolve beyond market expectations.

Fundamentals are unfavorable, making intervention alone insufficient. Ebury market strategist Matthew Ryan stresses that FX intervention only temporarily suppresses selling pressure, and without strong monetary policy backing, Japanese authorities will struggle to curb yen depreciation. UBS Asset Management sovereign‑and‑currency fixed‑income head Kevin Zhao even says that a brief yen rally sparked by government action would be a “sell‑the‑rally” opportunity.

Zhao analyses that the fundamental policies driving yen weakness have not changed: Prime Minister Kishida maintains expansionary fiscal policy despite massive debt, favoring a low‑rate environment, and “Abenomics does not imply a strong yen.” Moreover, even if the BOJ hikes rates, a simultaneous Fed hike would keep the US‑Japan spread wide, so rate hikes alone cannot sustain yen strength.

UBS Group strategists including Shahab Jalinoos note that data show speculative short‑yen positions have been fully absorbed. With arbitrage conditions still favorable and the US‑Japan rate spread remaining large, investors now have room to rebuild yen‑selling pressure.

Brown Brothers Harriman全球市場策略主管Elias Haddad表示，「目前市場關注的就是利率。」
「推動美元走高的是上周聯準會鷹派升息後的延續效應，這為美元帶來新的動能。本周公布的數據不多，與政策相關的數據更少，但有趣的是聯準會官員的談話，他們基本上都在傳達相同訊息，也就是未來還會進一步緊縮。」

paras_en: The dollar surged sharply on Wednesday (the 23rd), reaching its highest level in nearly two months as investors’ expectations for a near‑term Fed rate hike warmed. At the same time, Iran expressed doubts about progress in peace talks, pushing oil prices sharply higher.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.51% to 101.06, briefly climbing to 101.23 intraday – the highest since July 29.
The Fed raised rates by 25 basis points last week, moving the target range to 3.75%‑4.00%. Several Fed officials have since said that if inflation does not cool, further hikes may be needed.

Fed Governor Michael Barr said on Wednesday that the central bank took an important step last week to “re‑calibrate” short‑term borrowing costs to curb inflation, and that additional hikes could still be required.
Elias Haddad, head of global market strategy at Brown Brothers Harriman, said, “The market’s focus right now is on rates.”

“What is driving the dollar higher is the lingering effect of last week’s hawkish Fed hike, which gives the greenback fresh momentum. There are few data releases this week and even fewer policy‑related numbers, but the interesting part is the Fed officials’ remarks – they are essentially delivering the same message: further tightening is likely ahead.”

After S&P Global released the flash composite PMI output index, the dollar’s gains widened further. The index, covering manufacturing and services, rose to 58.4 this month – the highest since July 2021 and above August’s 56.0. Strong new orders lifted overall activity, but robust demand also strained supply chains and pushed up prices.

LSEG data show that after the PMI release, market expectations that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points at its October meeting rose to roughly 70%, up from about 53% before the data were out.
Middle‑East tensions lift oil prices

Another factor pushing the dollar higher is the rise in oil prices. In an interview with Iran’s state TV, Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, said that unless Iran’s conditions are met, the Strait of Hormuz will not be reopened and negotiations will not resume.

A senior Iranian official told Reuters that Iran and the United States still have major disagreements on how to end the war, but diplomatic efforts must continue. Earlier, Iran’s president said at the UN General Assembly that Tehran will never bow to U.S. pressure.

Outside observers had hoped that diplomatic activity during the UN General Assembly would produce a solution to the seven‑month‑long Iran conflict, a hope that had helped oil prices retreat from a four‑month high reached in mid‑September. This week, market sentiment has reversed.

Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said the Fed needs to “stay cautious” and may have to treat the current energy shock as a persistent source of inflation rather than assuming it will fade on its own.
Euro weakens, yen under pressure
The euro fell 0.51% against the dollar to $1.1389, marking a third consecutive trading‑day decline and the biggest single‑day drop in a week.

A flash composite PMI for the euro area released earlier showed that despite higher energy costs for businesses and households from the Middle‑East and Ukraine conflicts, the European economy displayed unexpected resilience.
Investors are also awaiting a meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, as the two powers remain at odds on trade, technology and the Iran war.
The dollar rose 0.17% against offshore yuan to 6.71 yuan.
The yen weakened 0.52% to 158.19 per dollar.

The Bank of Japan raised rates last week to the highest level in 31 years, but it has not convinced investors that further hikes are coming; traders are watching closely for any sign of intervention in the FX market.
Analysts note that Japan’s market is currently thin on liquidity due to a string of holidays, which could increase the likelihood of authorities stepping in.

市場對後續走勢看法分歧，巴克萊銀行預期利率將一路凍漲至2027年，但也有分析師認為，若高油價與聯準會升息壓力持續，央行第四季仍可能追加升息25個基點。
paras_en: Indonesia’s central bank on Wednesday (the 23rd) announced that it will keep the benchmark rate (the 7‑day reverse‑repo rate) at 5.75%, marking the third consecutive meeting of a hold. The overnight deposit rate and loan rate remain at 4.75% and 6.5% respectively. This was the first policy meeting after Destry Damayanti became the bank’s first female governor, and the decision matched market expectations.

The bank had raised rates by a total of 100 basis points in May and June of this year to defend the exchange rate. Governor Damayanti said the current policy aims to keep the rupiah stable, contain inflation and support economic growth.

Facing external uncertainties such as the Middle‑East situation, oil prices breaking $100 a barrel and the possibility of further Fed hikes, the central bank chose to use non‑rate innovative tools, further lowering the cost of hedging for foreign investors (reducing hedging‑exchange premium by up to 25% and domestic non‑deliverable forward premiums by up to 30%) and adopting a “the longer the funds stay, the higher the incentive” mechanism to attract foreign inflows.
After the decision was announced, the rupiah appreciated about 0.4% to around 17,800 per US dollar, and the stock market jumped 1.5%.
Indonesia’s August inflation rose to 3.19%, still within the 1.5%‑3.5% target band; the central bank kept its 2026 GDP growth forecast unchanged at 4.9%‑5.7%.

Market views on the next move diverge: Barclays expects rates to stay frozen until 2027, while some analysts argue that if high oil prices and Fed‑rate pressure persist, the bank could still add a 25‑basis‑point hike in the fourth quarter.

paras: ◆USD/JPY

芝加哥聯邦儲備銀行總裁古爾斯比與聖路易斯聯邦儲備銀行總裁穆薩萊姆均主張美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)進一步升息，並據美國總統川普表示願意會見將出席紐約舉行的聯合國大會的伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚，重燃兩國重啟談判的希望，導致油價下跌，提振市場情緒，而且日本央行(BOJ)上周調升利率，但兩名委員反對加息及缺乏明確鷹派指引，市場押注BOJ難以跟上全球主要央行的鷹派步伐，讓日本與主要經濟體之間維持較大利率差距，令日圓承壓，週二適逢日本假期休市，交投清淡，推動美元兌日圓觸及157.77高點。

據波士頓聯邦儲備銀行總裁柯林斯發文稱，因未來通貨膨脹持續高於2%目標的風險上升，支持FED上周加息，里奇蒙聯邦儲備銀行總裁巴爾金亦稱，美國經濟越來越強勁，通貨膨脹風險仍占上風，但上周傳言日本曾對美元兌日圓詢價，此舉被視為當局入市干預的前兆，限制日圓走貶，並據美國總統川普表示，伊朗一直與美國進行接觸，認為兩國最終將達成協議，而且油價下跌，緩解通貨膨脹擔憂，打壓美元兌日圓至156.80低點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於156.90-157.10，阻力於157.80-158.00。
◆EUR/USD

昨日紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)總裁布雷曼表示，經濟復甦和通貨膨脹前景面臨風險，但澳洲央行(RBA)助理總裁亨特重申，今年可能不得不第四次加息以控制通貨膨脹，並據RBA總裁布洛克稱，鑒於能源價格居高不下且國內需求持續過度，通貨膨脹面臨的上行風險可能正在顯現，市場分別加大押注RBA與RBNZ再加息，提振澳幣和紐元，而且消息人士透露，德國主要經濟研究機構包括WI研究所、伊福經濟研究所、IfW智庫、IWH以及DIW分別將今、明兩年經濟增長預期上調至1.3%及1.1%，帶動歐元兌美元盤整於1.1478高點。

隨後歐洲央行(ECB)首席經濟學家連恩表示，推高油氣價格的能源衝擊持續時間恐比ECB在3月預期的要長，地緣政治風險似乎再次升高，並據ECB指出，中國工業轉型正在將歐洲企業擠出全球市場，機械設備與運輸設備行業受影響尤為顯著，其中德國企業遭遇的衝擊最大，而且歐元區9月消費者信心指數較前月降1.0點至負16.5，推低歐元兌美元匯價至1.1428低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1450-70，支撐於1.1370-90。
◆GBP/USD

週二英國數據顯示8月公共部門借款達183億英鎊高於預期，並上修2026/27財政年前四個月借款數據，累計赤字再超出官方預測，增添財政大臣希首份預算案前壓力，打擊英鎊兌美元自1.3387高點下滑。據英國工業聯盟(CBI)公布9月工業訂單差值升至負9，但伊朗提議重開荷姆茲海峽，推動油價下跌，減輕英國央行(BOE)升息壓力，導致英鎊兌美元跌至1.3318低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3340-60，支撐於1.3250-70。

Chicago Fed President Goolsbee and St. Louis Fed President Mussailem both advocated further rate hikes by the Federal Reserve (FED). They noted that President Trump is willing to meet Iran’s President Raisi at the UN General Assembly in New York, reviving hopes for renewed negotiations between the two countries, which pushed oil prices lower and boosted market sentiment. The Bank of Japan (BOJ) raised rates last week, but two members opposed the hike and there was no clear hawkish guidance, leading the market to bet that the BOJ will struggle to keep pace with major central banks, widening interest‑rate differentials and pressuring the yen. Tuesday was a Japanese holiday with thin trading, driving USD/JPY up to a high of 157.77.

Boston Fed President Collins wrote that the risk of inflation staying above the 2% target is rising, supporting the Fed’s rate hike last week. Richmond Fed President Barkin also said the U.S. economy is getting stronger and inflation risks remain dominant. Last week rumors surfaced that Japan had queried USD/JPY rates, seen as a pre‑emptive intervention to curb yen weakness. President Trump said Iran is in contact with the U.S. and expects a deal, and falling oil prices eased inflation concerns, pushing USD/JPY down to a low of 156.80. The pair is expected to find support around 156.90‑157.10 and resistance near 157.80‑158.00.
EUR/USD

Yesterday the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) Governor Breman warned that the economic recovery and inflation outlook face risks, while RBA Deputy Governor Hunter reiterated that a fourth rate hike may be needed this year to tame inflation. RBA Governor Block added that persistent high energy prices and excess domestic demand are exposing upward inflation risks. Markets are increasing bets on further hikes by both the RBA and RBNZ, lifting the Australian and New Zealand dollars. Meanwhile, German research institutes (WI, Ifo, IfW, IWH, DIW) have raised their 2024‑25 growth forecasts to 1.3% and 1.1%, respectively, supporting the euro around the 1.1478 high against the dollar.

Subsequently ECB chief economist Lehn said the energy shock that is driving up oil and gas prices may last longer than the ECB expected in March, and geopolitical risks appear to be rising again. The ECB noted that China’s industrial transformation is pushing European firms out of global markets, hitting the machinery and transport equipment sectors hardest, especially German companies. Euro‑zone consumer confidence fell by 1.0 point to –16.5 in September, pulling the euro down to a low of 1.1428 against the dollar. The euro is expected to face resistance at 1.1450‑1.1470 and support at 1.1370‑1.1390 today.
GBP/USD

This added pressure to Chancellor Sunak’s upcoming budget and pushed the pound from a high of 1.3387 downwards. The CBI reported that September industrial orders fell to a gap of –9, but Iran’s proposal to reopen the Hormuz Strait lowered oil prices, easing pressure on the Bank of England’s rate‑hike outlook and sending the pound to a low of 1.3318. The pound is expected to face resistance at 1.3340‑1.3360 and support at 1.3250‑1.3270 today.
